tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

22	
23	1. **Paramètres (G1).**
24	   - `EnterPre` reçoit la clause G1 (`ParamOriginHidden`) ; `enter_params_protected` est prouvé.
25	   - Les deux contre-exemples de F6 de la passe 6 sont maintenant rejetés à `enterFrame`.
26	   - `call_protects_params_safe` reste **faux** sur des états atteints (`call_protects_params_safe_false`), par trois mécanismes que la clause d'entrée n'atteint pas : un ancêtre plus lointain que l'origine directe ; l'origine découverte pendant l'invocation par la libération d'autres autorités, suivie d'une écriture ; le ré-ancrage de la sortie. Voir (q).
27	   - Recherche ciblée : la séquence « attendue : aucune » existe. La libération du paramètre seule ne découvre jamais son origine (`release_keeps_origin_hidden`) ; ce sont d'autres libérations qui la découvrent.
28	2. **`store` sur une feuille (G2).**
29	   - Cible feuille, libre ; seule elle passe à `Init` ; clause d'arrivée (`store_keeps_target_reachable`).
30	   - F7 (a) : le second `store` est rejeté, par la seule clause d'arrivée ; le cycle de trois autorités aussi ; F7 (b) reste `ok`.
31	   - Mais la clause ne garde que `store` : le même cycle est atteint avec une autorité auxiliaire, refermé ensuite par `release`, `endUse`, `free` ou la sortie du cadre ((j), question (e) 2).
32	3. **`NoOrphan` (G3)** est démontré sur tous les états atteints et ajouté à leur invariant, par un invariant auxiliaire (`RootLive`). Il tient aussi dans les états où des autorités détenues ne sont exerçables par aucun cadre ; lu avec la couverture effective, il serait faux ((q)).
33	4. **`AnchorOrder` étendu aux autorités détenues (G4).** `AnchorOrderHeld` est vérifié dans l'état d'arrivée de `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` et `exitFrame`, préservé par les autres opérations, et ajouté à l'invariant des états atteints. `lb5` est rejeté au `transfer`, l'émission d'un bloc de l'appelé vers une valeur de l'appelant à l'`issue`. `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` est réénoncé sur le détenteur.
34	5. **Confirmations (G5)** : aucun changement nécessaire.
35	6. **Hors arbitrage, trouvé par la revue :** `transfer` et `issue` rendent `Init` des feuilles jamais écrites et font détenir une référence par une structure entière, ce que G2 interdit à `store` (question (e) 3).

375	## (q) Statut de `NoOrphan` et de `call_protects_params_safe`
376	
377	### `NoOrphan` (G3) : démontré
378	
379	`reachable_no_orphan` : sur tout état atteint, sous `DDSound k`, toute autorité active détenue par un emplacement est reliée à un cadre de la pile par une chaîne de détenteurs sans répétition, chaque maillon actif couvrant toutes les feuilles de l'emplacement qui détient le maillon suivant. `NoOrphan` est dans l'invariant des états atteints (`reachable_access_invariant_ext`).
380	
381	**Preuve.** Par l'invariant auxiliaire `RootLive`, préservé par chaque opération ((c) 8). La chaîne d'une autorité détenue par `q` est faite des racines des emplacements de la chaîne des propriétaires de `q`, du cadre jusqu'à `q` ; chacune couvre l'emplacement suivant, qui en est une partie ou possède la racine. Aucune opération, `store` ou autre, ne construit d'orphelin au sens de G3.
382	
383	**Ce que `NoOrphan` ne dit pas.** Une racine couvre son emplacement même quand elle n'y a plus de mode effectif. `NoOrphan` tient donc pour des raisons de structure, sans dire qu'une autorité détenue soit exerçable. Il tient dans chacun des états atteints suivants, où des autorités détenues ne sont exerçables par aucun cadre ((j)) :
384	- `held_unexercisable_by_transfer` : une autorité détenue par l'emplacement qu'elle couvre, après un `transfer` ;
385	- `held_unexercisable_by_issue` : un bloc émis vers une partie de sa propre région ;
386	- `f7a_cycle_by_release`, `cycle_by_exit`, `cycle_by_free` : des cycles de deux autorités stockées, chacune exerçable seulement par l'autre, refermés après les `store`, que le cadre courant n'exerce à aucun mode ; dans les deux premiers, aucune autorité n'est détenue par le cadre de base (`NothingAtFrame0`), donc aucun cadre de la pile ne les exerce.
387	
388	**Autre lecture.** Lu avec la couverture effective (chaque maillon a un mode effectif sur toutes les feuilles de l'emplacement suivant, `NoOrphanEff`), G3 serait faux sur les états atteints `hu1` et `iu1` (`noOrphanEff_fails`). La lecture « un maillon exerçable » n'a pas été étudiée. Question (e) 2.

390	### `call_protects_params_safe` (F6, gardé par G1) : faux
391	
392	`call_protects_params_safe_false` : ni la forme transitive (`CallProtects`) ni la forme directe (`CallProtectsDirect`) ne tiennent sur tous les états atteints. La preuve inductive demandée par G1 est donc impossible. Les témoins, tous acceptés par G1, relèvent de trois mécanismes :

395	   - `call_protects_params_safe_fails_grand` : l'appelant dérive 1 de sa racine, 2 de 1, 3 de 2 (`Modify` sur la feuille 0), et passe `[1, 3]`. L'origine directe de 3 est 2, détenue par l'appelant : G1 accepte. Dans l'appelé, 1 est exerçable, couvre la feuille 0 de 3 et en est un ancêtre. L'échec porte sur l'énoncé seul : 1 n'a pas de mode effectif sur 0 tant que 2 est active, même après `release 3`.
396	   - `call_arena_observe_block_param` : une arène passée en `Observe` rend `internal` exerçable en `Observe`, ancêtre du paramètre `Modify` dérivé d'un bloc ; échec sur l'énoncé seul.
397	2. **L'origine directe découverte pendant l'invocation** (`call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock`, `_unblock_active`, cas `ub0`…`ub14`). L'origine 4 du paramètre 5 est détenue par une structure `q` de l'appelant. À l'entrée, elle n'est exerçable à aucun mode : le paramètre 6, `Modify` sur `q`, n'y a pas de mode effectif, ses descendants 7 et 8 couvrant chacun un champ de `q` ; 7 et 8 sont détenus par les champs d'une structure `w` sur laquelle le paramètre 9 donne `Modify`. `CallProtects` tient à l'entrée. L'appelé libère 7 et 8 (C4) : 6 retrouve `Modify` effectif sur `q`, et 4 est exerçable, que 5 soit encore actif ou déjà libéré. Après `release 5`, l'appelé écrit la feuille 0 par 4. C'est le dommage que F6 voulait exclure.
398	3. **Le ré-ancrage de la sortie** (O7, A7 ; `call_protects_params_safe_fails_exit`, `_exit_strict`). Un cadre repasse son paramètre 1 à un appelé, qui en dérive une autorité, la stocke dans une valeur de son appelant et sort. La sortie libère ce qui meurt avec l'appelé et rattache l'autorité stockée à la racine du premier appelant. De retour dans le cadre 2, elle est exerçable, couvre la feuille du paramètre 1 et n'en descend plus, bien qu'elle en soit issue ; le cadre 2 écrit par elle. La variante `_exit_strict` respecte la lecture stricte d'A3 (chaque paramètre dérivé par son appelant). Aucune clause d'entrée ne peut empêcher ce cas : il naît à la sortie.
399	
400	**Ce qui tient.**
401	- `call_params_effective_protected` (conservé) : tant qu'un paramètre `Modify` est actif, toute autorité de mode effectif présent sur ses feuilles est lui ou un de ses descendants.
402	- `enter_params_protected` : à l'entrée, la clause G1 et cette exclusivité.
403	- `release_keeps_origin_hidden` : la libération d'un paramètre `Modify`, à elle seule, ne rend jamais son origine directe exerçable. Le `release` ne change le mode effectif d'aucune autre autorité que le paramètre et son origine (`release_effective_other`), et l'exercice d'une autorité dans l'état d'arrivée se ramène à son exercice avant, sauf à passer par l'origine elle-même.

# Tâche : MM-03.3 — jalon 1, passe 7 (paramètres protégés, store sur feuille, autorités sans orphelin, autorités détenues dans AnchorOrder)

## Git
Même branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite. Pas de merge, pas de PR. Tout sous `formal/`. `Ern/MM02.lean` inchangé. Spec jointe : MM-03.3 v0.2, non copiée ; arbitrages A1–A11, B1–B10, C1–C9, D1–D4, F1–F7 en vigueur, sauf ce que les arbitrages ci-dessous remplacent ; ceux-ci font foi.

## Langue
Code, docstrings, commentaires, messages de commit en anglais. Rapport en français.

## Arbitrages (font foi)
G1. Paramètres.
  - `EnterPre` : pour tout paramètre `P` de mode `Modify` doté d'une origine, cette origine n'est exerçable, à aucun mode, dans l'état où le nouveau cadre a reçu ses paramètres. Seule l'origine directe est contrainte.
  - `enter_params_protected` : la configuration des paramètres à l'entrée satisfait cette clause et l'exclusivité.
  - `call_protects_params_safe` (énoncé de F6, passe 6) : sur tout état atteint pendant l'invocation, y compris après `release`, `store`, `transfer` et dans les appels imbriqués. La preuve est inductive sur les pas de `Reachable` ; elle ne se réduit pas à la précondition d'entrée. S'il reste faux, rapporter le contre-exemple sans affaiblir l'énoncé.
  - Docstring : accès sûrs du noyau seulement ; aucune conséquence sur `noalias` n'est tirée ici (jalon 2 et traduction bas niveau).
G2. `store`.
  - `p` est une feuille (emplacement d'une référence). Effet sur l'initialisation : cette seule feuille passe à `Init`.
  - `p` ne détient aucune autorité active ; sinon `reject`. Écraser une feuille `Init` sans autorité est permis.
  - Dans l'état d'arrivée, `p` reste `Modify` exerçable par le cadre courant (`store_keeps_target_reachable`).
G3. Absence d'autorité orpheline. Invariant `NoOrphan` : toute autorité active détenue par un emplacement est reliée à un cadre de la pile par une chaîne finie de détenteurs, sans répétition, dont chaque maillon est une autorité active qui couvre l'emplacement détenteur du maillon suivant. Ajouté à l'invariant des états atteints. Préservation par toutes les opérations ; s'il est faux, rapporter le contre-exemple atteignable.
G4. `AnchorOrder` étendu aux autorités détenues : pour tout emplacement utilisable `q` et toute autorité active détenue par `q`, le cadre de l'ancre effective de cette autorité est le cadre de `q` ou un de ses ancêtres. Vérifié dans l'état d'arrivée par **toute** opération qui crée ou déplace une relation de détention : `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame`, ré-ancrage à la sortie. `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` est réénoncé sur le détenteur et prouvé sans restriction à `store`.
G5. Confirmations : deux arènes vivantes sur les mêmes feuilles avec des `internal` différents sont légales (`y3`), sans disjonction globale ajoutée ; « nœuds » de F7 (b) désigne les valeurs détentrices des blocs ; les choix (c) de la passe 6 sur `newArena` et `StaticPinnedBottom` sont confirmés.

## Étapes (un commit par étape)
1. G1 : clause de `EnterPre`, `enter_params_protected`, `call_protects_params_safe` et sa forme transitive ; `call_params_effective_protected` conservé.
2. G2 : `store` restreint, `store_keeps_target_reachable`, préservation.
3. G3 : `NoOrphan`, préservation, intégration à l'invariant des états atteints.
4. G4 : `AnchorOrder` étendu, contrôles de `transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` et du ré-ancrage, préservation.
5. Cas, depuis `S3.init` par des pas de `Reachable`, chaque rejet avec son jumeau positif :
   - `call_protects_params_safe_fails_param` et `_fails_owned` : appel rejeté à `enterFrame` ; jumeau : paramètres sur deux locaux distincts → `ok` ;
   - arène passée en `Observe` et paramètre `Modify` dérivé d'un bloc détenu par une valeur de l'appelant → `ok` ;
   - recherche ciblée : séquence d'invocation où l'origine directe d'un paramètre, non exerçable à l'entrée, le devient après sa libération (attendu : aucune ; sinon contre-exemple) ;
   - `store` dans le champ référence d'une structure dont le champ `length` reste `Uninit`, puis lecture de `length` → `reject` ; `store` sur la structure entière → `reject` ;
   - `store` dans une feuille qui détient déjà une autorité → `reject` ; `release` puis `store` → `ok` ;
   - `fa7`, `store 8 6` → `reject` ; cycle de trois autorités sur trois nœuds → le dernier `store` rejeté ; F7 (b) inchangé → `ok` de bout en bout ;
   - `lb5`, `transfer 5 0` → `reject` au `transfer` ; jumeau : arène dont le stockage est possédé par l'appelant, bloc émis dans l'appelé puis rendu → `ok` ;
   - l'appelé émet directement un bloc de son arène locale vers une valeur de l'appelant reçue en paramètre `Modify` → `reject` à `issue` ; jumeau : même émission vers un local de l'appelé → `ok` ;
   - tous les cas des passes précédentes rejoués ; tout verdict qui change est listé et justifié.

## Hors périmètre
Pool de handles, jalon 2, `noalias` et traduction bas niveau, concurrence, flot de contrôle, suspension, `defer`, obligation de libération, syntaxe, corpus MM3-H complet.

## Règles
Zéro `sorry` ; `#print axioms` au plus {propext, Quot.sound} ; aucun `noncomputable` ; `lake build` sans avertissement ; docstrings citant la clause ou l'arbitrage ; rien d'inventé ; aucun énoncé affaibli, tout changement justifié ; revue adverse centrée sur G1 (appel légal rejeté à tort, contre-exemple résiduel à F6), G2 (lecture d'une feuille jamais écrite), G3 (orphelin construit par une autre opération que `store`) ; contre-exemples conservés.

## Livrable
Module commité ; `formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p7.md` : sections (a)–(o) comme en passe 6, plus (p) verdicts qui changent par rapport à la passe 6, chacun avec sa cause ; (q) statut de `NoOrphan` et de `call_protects_params_safe`.

access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, for the authorities held by the value
and by the places it owns, which change holder or frame. O4.3 holds by construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
    True) ∧
  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance

/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => .frame f

/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
earlier local (A5). -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
`nF` pushed; the parameters, derived by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
arbitrage 2; A4); the ghost record `callParams` of the new frame is `ps` (F6). -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q
    arenas := s.arenas
    callParams := fun f => if f = s.nF then ps else s.callParams f }

/-- G1, for one parameter `p` and the state `s'` where the new frame has received its parameters:
if `p` is a `Modify` authority with an origin, that origin, its direct origin only, is
exercisable (A2, B2) at no mode in `s'`. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` before G1 and G4 (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active
(non-empty stack); each parameter is an active authority derived by the caller and held by it
(A3); the parent and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its
parent. -/
def EnterPreBase (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.F ≠ [] ∧
  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPreBase s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPreBase; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): those of `EnterPreBase`; G1: in
`enterEff s ps ls`, the state where the new frame has received its parameters, the direct origin of
every `Modify` parameter is exercisable at no mode (`ParamOriginHidden`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in
the arrival state. -/
def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  EnterPreBase s ps ls ∧ (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). A7 speaks of an authority held by
a surviving frame; an authority held by a place is read as held by the frame that ends its
owner chain. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (A7). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): released unless it survives; a surviving
authority is re-attached to its first surviving strict ancestor along `origin`, which is its
origin when that origin survives. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4; A5; A7): return to the caller; each anchor
replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its ancestors; authorities that do
not survive released; surviving derived authorities re-attached. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  match s.F with
  | _ :: F₀ =>
    { s with
      F := F₀
      D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
      A := mapI (exitG s F₀) 0 s.A }
  | [] => s

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7; B4): the exiting frame has a caller; every
anchor of a place still usable after the exit has a surviving authority among itself and its
ancestors along `origin`; every surviving derived authority has a surviving strict ancestor;
B4: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame, transitively owned storage included, is
pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival
state, after the re-anchoring. Otherwise the exit is rejected. -/
def ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  match s.F with
  | _ :: F₀ => F₀ ≠ [] ∧
      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
        ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s F₀ a → s.org a ≠ none →
        firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
        ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
      AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)
  | [] => False

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) := by
  unfold ExitPre; split <;> infer_instance

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-- Non-escape restriction (MM-03.3.6) for anchor `x` and a destination of frame `fd`: if `x`
is a local anchor (no origin), its frame is `fd` or an ancestor of it, so `fd` does not outlive
it. The frame of an anchor is the frame of its holder (A4, A5). -/
def NoEscape (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.origin = none →
    OptP (s.hframe y.holder) (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) True) True) True

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (NoEscape s x fd) := by
  unfold NoEscape; infer_instance

/-- C1: the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is `fd`, the frame of the dependent,
or one of its ancestors (MM-03.3.1, `ancestor`). The frame of an authority is the frame of its
holder (A4, A5). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (G4): for every usable place `q` and every active
authority held by `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of that authority is the frame of `q` or
one of its ancestors (`EffAnchorOK`, C1). -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

----
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- The current frame has an authority exercisable at mode `m` whose effective mode permits `m` on
every leaf of `q` (B2: an operation requires the mode it requests). -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-! ## Outcomes and guarded relations (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject

/-- Common form of the transition rules of MM-03.3 §3–5: `ok` with the effect when the
precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
----
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance

/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5): the destination becomes
`Init`, the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited ones included, join those of
the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority held by the source or one
of its parts is now held by the destination (A4); every place owned by the source or one of its
parts is now owned by the destination, without moving (A5). -/

· subst_vars; simp [hy, skel]
    · rfl

theorem store_get {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (j : Nat) :
    (storeEff s a p).A[j]? = if a = j then some { y with holder := .place p } else s.A[j]? := by
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]; exact set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy)

theorem store_pre_auth {s : S3} {a : Nat}
    (h : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False) :
    ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top := by
  have h1 := h; unfold OptP at h1
  split at h1
  · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, h1⟩
  · exact h1.elim

/-- `store` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (F4): it changes the holder of a derived authority to a
usable place, adds an active anchor, and writes leaves. `RootHeld` is untouched: `a` is derived. -/
theorem store_preserves {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  have hp := hpre.2.1
  have sk := store_skel s a p
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have hn : (storeEff s a p).nF = s.nF := by rw [e]
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.origin hwf.origin, by rw [hP]; exact sk.fp hwf.fp, hF ▸ hwf.ne, hF ▸ hwf.nodup,
    by rw [hF, hn]; exact hwf.frames, by rw [hP, hn]; exact hwf.ownerFrame,
----
      exact ⟨j, z₀, hz₀, ez.2.2.2 ▸ za, ez.2.2.1 ▸ hl⟩)

/-- `store_root_rejected` (F4): storing an authority without origin, a root, is rejected. -/
theorem store_root_rejected {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ho : y.origin = none) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    obtain ⟨y', hy', -, ho', -⟩ := store_pre_auth h.1
    rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'; exact ho' ho

/-- `store_keeps_target_reachable` (G2): after an `ok` store, the target leaf `p` is still
exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame. -/
theorem store_keeps_target_reachable {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    HasRight s' .modify p := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1

/-- `store` writes one leaf (G2): the target `p` is a leaf, and it is the only leaf whose
initialisation changes, becoming `Init`. -/
theorem store_writes_one_leaf {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    isLeaf s.P p ∧ s'.I p = .init ∧ ∀ l, l ≠ p → s'.I l = s.I l := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre.1
  rw [storeEff_eq hy]
  exact ⟨hpre.2.2.2.2.2.1, by simp, fun l hl => by simp [hl]⟩

/-- `store` into a leaf that holds an active authority is rejected (G2). -/
theorem store_occupied_rejected {s : S3} {a p j : Nat} {z : Authority} (hz : s.A[j]? = some z)
    (za : z.active = true) (hzp : z.holder = .place p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    have := h.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    simp only [OptP, hz] at this
    exact this za hzp

/-- `store` into a place with parts, such as a whole structure, is rejected (G2). -/
theorem store_nonleaf_rejected {s : S3} {a p r : Nat} (hr : r < s.P.length)
    (hpr : parentOf s.P r = some p) : StoreStep a p s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => h.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr hpr

theorem mem_of_mem_dropWhile {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ {l : List Nat} {x : Nat}, x ∈ l.dropWhile p → x ∈ l
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | b :: l, x, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons] at h
    split at h
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_of_mem_dropWhile h)
    · exact h

/-- `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer`, the pass-6 statement of `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer`,
kept on the anchors (F4; MM-03.3.1: « Un accès temporaire ne peut être
prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien »; MM-03.3.6; C1): a value `src`,
one of whose parts (`src` included) is anchored on an authority `a` whose effective anchor does
not move with the value and is of the current frame `f`, such as an authority derived from a
local of `f` and stored into `src` or one of its fields, cannot be transferred to a destination
whose frame, after the transfer, is an older frame `g`: the dependency follows the value
(`depsOf`, MM-03.3.6; MM-03.3 §3, O4) and the clause B8 of `transfer` checks its effective
anchor. An effective anchor that moves with the value, the root of storage the value owns,
travels with it (A5). The theorem speaks of the authorities placed by `store`, which anchors
them; a block issued to `src` is held without being an anchor (pass-6 report, (d) 3). -/
theorem anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : a ∈ depsOf s src)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hin : a ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D dst := by
    simp only [transferEff, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_right _ ha
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 dst
    (List.mem_range.2 (by have := hdst.lt; simpa [transferEff] using this)) hdst a hin (.inr (.inl rfl))
  rw [transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

/-- `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` (F4, restated on the holder by G4; MM-03.3.1: « Un accès
temporaire ne peut être prolongé simplement en le stockant dans un cadre plus ancien »; C1): a
value `src`, one of whose parts (`src` included) holds an active authority `a` whose effective
anchor does not move with the value and is of the current frame `f`, cannot be transferred to a
destination whose frame, after the transfer, is an older frame `g`: the authority follows the
value (A4) and G4 checks its effective anchor in the arrival state. No restriction to `store`:
the authority may have been placed by `store`, `issue` or an earlier `transfer`. -/
theorem store_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {y z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : s.A[a]? = some y)
    (ya : y.active = true) (hh : heldIn s.P src y.holder)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have ha' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some { y with holder := .place dst } := by
    rw [transfer_A_get, ha]; simp [hh]
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 dst hdst a _ ha' ya rfl
  rw [transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

/-! ## Absence of orphan authorities (G3) -/

/-- G3, one link of a chain of holders: `a` is an active authority that covers the place holding
`b`, every leaf of that place being in the footprint of `a`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list related by `R`. -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (G3): every active authority held by a place is linked to a frame of the stack by a
finite chain of holders without repetition: the chain starts with an active authority held by a
frame of the stack, ends with the authority, and each link is an active authority that covers the
place holding the next link (`CoversHolder`). -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

theorem linked_cons {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {a : Nat} {l : List Nat} :
    Linked R (a :: l) ↔ (∀ b, l.head? = some b → R a b) ∧ Linked R l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [Linked]
  | cons b l => simp [Linked]

theorem linked_dropWhile {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {p : Nat → Bool} :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, Linked R l → Linked R (l.dropWhile p)
  | [], h => h
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    split
    · exact linked_dropWhile (linked_cons.1 h).2
    · exact h

theorem getLast?_cons_ne {a : Nat} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, l ≠ [] → (a :: l).getLast? = l.getLast?
  | [], h => absurd rfl h
  | _ :: _, _ => by simp [List.getLast?_cons_cons]

theorem getLast?_append_single {x : Nat} : ∀ (l : List Nat), (l ++ [x]).getLast? = some x
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    rw [List.cons_append, getLast?_cons_ne (by simp)]; exact getLast?_append_single l

theorem getLast?_dropWhile {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, l.dropWhile p ≠ [] →
    (l.dropWhile p).getLast? = l.getLast?
  | [], h => absurd rfl h
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons] at h ⊢
    split at h
    · rename_i hb; simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte]
      have hl : l ≠ [] := fun e => by subst e; exact h rfl
      rw [getLast?_dropWhile h, getLast?_cons_ne hl]
    · rename_i hb; simp only [hb]; rfl

theorem length_dropWhile_le {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ (l : List Nat), (l.dropWhile p).length ≤ l.length
  | [] => Nat.le_refl _
  | b :: l => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    split
    · exact Nat.le_trans (length_dropWhile_le l) (Nat.le_succ _)
    · exact Nat.le_refl _

theorem dropWhile_ne_of_mem {a : Nat} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, a ∈ l →
    ∃ t, l.dropWhile (· != a) = a :: t
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    by_cases e : b = a
    · subst e; simp
    · have : (b != a) = true := by simp [e]
      simp only [this, ↓reduceIte]
      exact dropWhile_ne_of_mem (by rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with h | h
                                    · exact absurd h.symm e
                                    · exact h)

/-- Removes the loops of a walk (G3, chains without repetition): the first element is kept, and
an element that occurs again later cuts the walk to its later occurrence. `n` is a fuel, at least
the length. -/
def dropLoops : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, l => l
  | _ + 1, [] => []

theorem linked_append {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {i x : Nat} (hr : R i x) :

/-! ### Root authorities of usable places -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant for G3: every usable root place has an active authority without origin,
held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the place (A4; B1). -/
def RootLive (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), s.A[i]? = some z ∧
    z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧
    ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

theorem WF3.parent_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {i o : Nat} (h : parentOf s.P i = some o) :
    o < i ∧ o < s.P.length := by
  simp only [parentOf] at h
  cases hp : s.P[i]? with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; cases h
  | some pl =>
    rw [hp] at h
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -⟩ := hw.parts i pl o hp h
    exact ⟨hlt, lt_of_getElem? hpr⟩

/-- Every place of a well-formed state is a part of a root place (MM-03.3.2). -/
theorem exists_rootPlace {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) : ∀ n q, q < n → q < s.P.length →
    ∃ r, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P q r
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hqn, hq => by
    cases hp : parentOf s.P q with
    | none => exact ⟨q, ⟨hq, hp⟩, hq, .inl rfl⟩
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, hol⟩ := hw.parent_lt hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hor⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw n o (by omega) hol
      refine ⟨r, hr, hq, .inr ?_⟩
      rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
      rcases hor with rfl | hor
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hor

theorem chain_trans {org : Nat → Option Nat} (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ r, r ∈ chain org i → ∀ o ∈ chain org r, o ∈ chain org i
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hi, r, hr, o, ho => by
    cases hp : org i with
    | none => rw [chain_none hp] at hr; simp at hr
    | some p =>
      have hpi := hlt i p hp
      rw [chain_cons hp hpi] at hr ⊢
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (chain_trans hlt n p (by omega) r hr o ho)

/-- The footprint of a part is within the footprint of the whole (MM-03.3.2). -/
theorem footprint_sub {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {q r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P q r) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : l ∈ footprint s.P r := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  refine mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hqr⟩ := h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hlq
  · exact hqr
  · rcases hqr with rfl | hqr
    · exact .inr hlq
    · exact .inr (chain_trans (fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1) (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q
        hlq r hqr)

/-- The root authority of the root place of a usable place `q` covers `q` and is held by the owner
of `q` (G3, under `RootLive`). -/
theorem rootLive_cover {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hr : RootLive s) {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl) (hq : s.Usable q) :
    ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.holder = pl.owner ∧
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ z.footprint := by
  obtain ⟨r, hrp, hqr⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (q + 1) q (Nat.lt_succ_self q) (lt_of_getElem? hpl)
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, -, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ := hr r hrp (usable_of_part hw hqr hq)
  obtain ⟨pl', pr', hpl', hpr', he⟩ := hw.ownerOf hqr
  rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [hpr] at hpr'; cases hpr'
  exact ⟨i, z, hz, za, by rw [hzh, he], fun l hl => (hzf l).2 (footprint_sub hw hqr hl)⟩

theorem coversHolder_of {s : S3} {i x : Nat} {z y : Authority} {q : Nat} (hz : s.A[i]? = some z)
    (za : z.active = true) (hx : s.A[x]? = some y) (hh : y.holder = .place q)
    (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ z.footprint) : CoversHolder s i x := by
  simp only [CoversHolder, OptP, hx, hh]
  exact ⟨⟨z, hz, za⟩, fun l hl => by simp only [S3.afp, hz]; exact hc l hl⟩

/-- Under `RootLive`, an active authority held by a usable place is linked to a frame of the stack
by a chain of holders, possibly with repetitions: the roots along the owner chain (G3). -/
theorem chain_to_frame {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hr : RootLive s) {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) :
    ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
      ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧
        z.active = true ∧ z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
        Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c) := by
  induction hq with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    intro x y hx ya hh
    obtain ⟨i, z, hz, za, hzh, hzf⟩ := rootLive_cover hw hr hpl (.frame hpl hd ho hf)
    exact ⟨i, z, f, [x], hz, za, by rw [hzh, ho], hf, rfl,
      ⟨coversHolder_of hz za hx hh hzf, trivial⟩⟩
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho hu ih =>
    intro x y hx ya hh
    obtain ⟨i, z, hz, za, hzh, hzf⟩ := rootLive_cover hw hr hpl (.place hpl hd ho hu)
    obtain ⟨a₀, z₀, f, c, h0, h0a, h0h, hf, hlast, hlink⟩ := ih i z hz za (by rw [hzh, ho])
    refine ⟨a₀, z₀, f, c ++ [x], h0, h0a, h0h, hf, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← List.cons_append]; exact getLast?_append_single _
    · rw [← List.cons_append]; exact linked_append (coversHolder_of hz za hx hh hzf) hlink hlast

/-- `NoOrphan` (G3) follows from `WF3` and `RootLive`: an active authority held by a place has a
usable holder (possession, `WF3`), the roots along the owner chain of that holder form a chain of
holders to a frame of the stack, and the loops of that chain can be removed (`dropLoops`). -/
theorem noOrphan_of_rootLive {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hr : RootLive s) : NoOrphan s := by
  intro x y q hx ya hh
  have hq : s.Usable q := by have := hw.poss x y hx ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
  obtain ⟨a₀, z, f, c, hz, za, hzh, hf, hlast, hlink⟩ := chain_to_frame hw hr hq x y hx ya hh
  have hhd := dropLoops_head (c.length + 1) (a₀ :: c)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, dropLoops (c.length + 1) (a₀ :: c) = a₀ :: t := by
    cases e : dropLoops (c.length + 1) (a₀ :: c) with
    | nil => exact absurd e (dropLoops_ne_nil (by simp))
    | cons b t => rw [e] at hhd; cases hhd; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨a₀, z, f, t, hz, za, hzh, hf, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← ht]; exact dropLoops_nodup _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)

/-- A root authority held by a usable place satisfies the condition of G4: it is its own effective
anchor, of the frame of its holder (C1). -/
theorem effAnchorOK_root_held {s : S3} {x q : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y)
    (ho : y.origin = none) (hh : y.holder = .place q) (hq : s.Usable q) :
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) := by
  have he : s.effAnchor x = x :=
    effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) x (.inl rfl) (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho])
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have hpf : s.pframe q = some f := pframe_iff.2 hf
  unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [he, hy]
  simp only [OptP, hh, S3.hframe, hpf]
  exact ancestor_self hfF

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over to a state with the same places and stack, fewer usable places,
the same chains of origins and holders for the existing authorities, and no new active authority
held by a place (G4). -/
theorem AnchorOrderHeld.of {s s' : S3} (ho : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s'.Usable q → s.Usable q)
    (hanc : ∀ a, a < s.A.length → s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)
    (hA : ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y →
      ∃ y', s'.A[x]? = some y' ∧ y'.origin = y.origin ∧ y'.holder = y.holder)
    (hback : ∀ (x q : Nat) (y' : Authority), s'.A[x]? = some y' → y'.active = true →
      y'.holder = .place q → ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .place q) :
    AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  intro q hq x y' hx ya hh
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya₀, hh₀⟩ := hback x q y' hx ya hh
  have hok := ho q (hu q hq) x y hy ya₀ hh₀
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (hanc x hok.lt)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e2⟩ := hA _ z hz
  exact (effAnchorOK_of_same hz (by rw [he]; exact hz') (by rw [e2, S3.hframe_congr hP])
    (fun g f _ => by rw [hF]) (S3.pframe_congr hP q)).2 hok

/-- An active authority held by a place after releases was active and held by it before. -/
theorem OnlyReleases.back {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) {x q : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hx : s₁.A[x]? = some y') (ya : y'.active = true) (hh : y'.holder = .place q) :
    ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .place q := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, -, e, ha⟩ := h.2 x y' hx
  exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya, e ▸ hh⟩

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O1): the new authority is held by the
frame; the others keep holders and chains. -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode}
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  refine h.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ ha => ancs_addAuth_lt ha)
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by rw [deriveEff, addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun x q y' hx ya hh => ?_
  rcases addAuth_get hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨y', hx', ya, hh⟩
  · cases hh

/-- `split` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O2): the new authorities are held by the
frame. -/
theorem split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  refine h.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl)
    (fun a ha => chain_congr fun j hj => by
      simp only [S3.org]; show ((s.A ++ _)[j]?).bind _ = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)])
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by
      show (s.A ++ _)[x]? = _; rw [List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy,
      rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun x q y' hx ya hh => ?_
  have hx' : (s.A ++ rs.map fun r => (⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ : Authority))[x]? =
    some y' := hx
  by_cases hxl : x < s.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hxl] at hx'; exact ⟨y', hx', ya, hh⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_map] at hx'
    cases hr : rs[x - s.A.length]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at hx'; cases hx'
    | some r => rw [hr] at hx'; cases hx'; cases hh

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over when authorities are only released and places, stack and
usability do not grow (G4). -/
theorem releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld {s s₁ : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁) (hP : s₁.P = s.P) (hF : s₁.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q) : AnchorOrderHeld s₁ :=
  h.of hP hF hu (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs; rw [hr.org]) (fun _ _ hy => hr.fwd hy)
    fun _ _ _ hx ya hh => hr.back hx ya hh

/-- `release` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
theorem release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h (release_releases s a) hP hF
    fun _ hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over when authorities, places, stack and `dead` flags are unchanged
(G4): `depend`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`, `newArena`, `reset`. -/
theorem sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hA : s'.A = s.A)
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : AnchorOrderHeld s' :=
  h.of hP hF (fun _ hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq)
    (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs S3.org; rw [hA]) (fun _ y hy => ⟨y, by rw [hA]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun _ _ y' hx ya hh => ⟨y', by rw [← hA]; exact hx, ya, hh⟩

/-- `endUse` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; A6). -/
theorem endUse_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h ((endUseS_releases s p).trans cleanup_releases) rfl rfl
    fun q hq => S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseEff s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq

/-- `free` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; A6). -/
theorem free_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p a : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : FreeStep k p a s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h ((freeS_releases s p).trans cleanup_releases) rfl rfl
    fun q hq => S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := freeEff s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by simp only [freeEff, cleanup, freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq

/-- `alloc` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4), under `WF3`: the frames of old places do not change,
and each new root authority held by a place is its own effective anchor, of the frame of that
place. -/
theorem alloc_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {pv ow : Nat}
    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {s s' : S3} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : AllocStep k pv ow ls s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  cases hs with
  | ok _ _ =>
  intro q hq x y hx ya hh
  rcases alloc_get hx with ⟨hxl, hx'⟩ | ⟨-, i, -, rfl⟩
  · have hq0 : s.Usable q := by have := hwf.poss x y hx' ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this
    have hok := h q hq0 x y hx' ya hh
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hok.frame hz
    have he : (allocEff s pv ow ls).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
      effAnchor_congr (alloc_ancs_lt hxl)
    have hrl : s.effAnchor x < s.A.length := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (effAnchor_le s x) hxl
    refine (effAnchorOK_of_same (s' := allocEff s pv ow ls) (z' := z) hz (by
      rw [he, alloc_lt hrl]; exact hz) ?_ (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl)
      (alloc_pframe_old hwf hq0.lt)).2 hok
    cases hzh : z.holder with
    | frame f => rfl
    | place p =>
      rw [hzh] at hg
      exact alloc_pframe_old hwf (pframe_iff.1 hg).lt
  · exact effAnchorOK_root_held hx rfl hh hq

/-! ## Redundant preconditions (A11) -/

/-- O1.4 follows from O1.1 and O1.3 under I1 (MM-03.3 §3, O1; A11): it is not a precondition of
`derive`. -/
theorem derive_compat_redundant {s : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (h1 : I1 s) (hs : s.Active src)
    (h3 : ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m) : DeriveCompat s src q m := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hs
  have hI := addAuth_I1 (hd := .frame s.top) h1 hx h3
  intro b hb p hpq
  have hn : effective (deriveEff s src q m) s.A.length p = some m := by
    rw [deriveEff, effective_eq (addAuth_self _ _) rfl hpq]
    have : descModes (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩)
        s.A.length p = [] := by
      apply nil_of_forall_not_mem; intro e he
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy, -, -, hj, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 he
      have h1 := chain_lt hj
      have h2 := lt_of_getElem? hy; simp [S3.addAuth] at h2; omega
    simp [this, effOf]
  cases he : effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p with
  | none => trivial
  | some e => exact effective_compat hI b _ p e m (by have := List.mem_range.1 hb; omega) he hn

/-- The removed clause of `canWrite3` follows from its first clause under I1 (MM-03.3 §5;
A11). -/
theorem canWrite3_excl_redundant {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hw : canWrite3 s a ls) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none :=
  fun p hp _ hb => effective_exclusive h1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw.2 p hp).1

/-! ## Arena (MM-03.3 §6, A10) -/

/-- The place of the arena value: the holder of `internal` (F1, replacing the owner of the storage
of A10 and D3). -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[ar.internal]? with
  | some y =>
    match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- Metadata leaves of the arena: the footprint of the arena value (A10). -/
def metaLeaves (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : List Nat :=
  match arenaValue s ar with
  | some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1; F2). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the
administered storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions
disjoint; available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions
within the storage. Clause of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal`
on its region. F2: the storage is a place of `P`, owned by anything (a local, a static, an
allocated root, a block): the ownership clause of A10 is removed. F1: `internal` is a `Modify`
authority held by a place, the arena value, and covers exactly the footprint of the storage. -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  ar.storage < s.P.length ∧
  (∃ (y : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    y.holder = .place v) ∧
  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10; C6, aligned with `ProviderRight`): exercisable
`Modify` on the arena value, or an authority `via` exercisable at `Observe` (B2) with a present
effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with valid
dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s ar) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False ∨
  (s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
    ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination value; the destination and the metadata become `Init`;
the region leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∨ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)
