instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; G4: `reject` when the arrival state,
where the block is held by `dst`, breaks `AnchorOrderHeld`; `ok` otherwise. A failed `issue`
creates no holding relation and has no arrival state, so G4 is not checked before `fail`. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noAnchor : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)
    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `ok` outcome of `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 ∧
      (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with
    | ok h1 h2 h3 h4 => exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, e⟩
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3 h4

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
----
  obtain ⟨hwf, hinv, hai⟩ := reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h
  intro ar har ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  have hi := hai ar har ⟨y, hy, ya⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hwf (s.P.length + 1) ar.storage (by omega)
    hi.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by
    have := (hi.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 l).2 hl
    simpa [S3.afp, hy] using this
  exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => hinv.nd ar.internal y hy ya ar.storage hu l hl hly

/-- `RootLive` on the reached states (G3; auxiliary invariant): every usable root place keeps an
active root authority held by its owner. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_rootLive {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : RootLive s := by
  induction h with
  | init _ => exact init_rootLive _
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | split _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | release _ hs ih => exact release_rootLive ih hs
  | transfer hr hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact transfer_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 hpre.1 ih
  | depend _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | enter hr hs ih => exact enter_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | exit _ hs ih => exact exit_rootLive ih hs
  | read _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | pin _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | unpin _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | endUse _ hs ih => exact endUse_rootLive ih hs
  | free _ hs ih => exact free_rootLive ih hs
  | alloc hr hs ih => exact alloc_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | newArena _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | issue _ hs ih =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      cases hst with
      | ok => exact ih.of_append rfl rfl rfl _ rfl
  | reset _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split
    · exact ih.of_sameA rfl rfl rfl rfl
    · exact ih
  | store _ hs ih => exact store_rootLive ih hs

/-- `reachable_no_orphan` (G3): in every reached state, every active authority held by a place is
linked to a frame of the stack by a finite chain of holders without repetition (`NoOrphan`).
Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_no_orphan {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : NoOrphan s :=
  noOrphan_of_rootLive (reachable_invariants hdd h).1 (reachable_rootLive hdd h)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` on the reached states (G4): for every usable place and every active authority
it holds, the frame of the effective anchor is the frame of the place or one of its ancestors.
`transfer`, `issue`, `store`, `enterFrame` and the exit check it in their arrival state; the other
operations preserve it. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : AnchorOrderHeld s := by
  induction h with
  | init _ =>
    intro q hq x y hx _ hh
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := init_get hx
    exact effAnchorOK_root_held hx rfl hh hq
  | derive _ hs ih => exact derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | split _ hs ih => exact split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | release _ hs ih => exact release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | transfer _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  | depend _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | enter _ hs ih => obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2
  | exit _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold ExitPre at hpre; split at hpre
    · exact hpre.2.2.2.2
    · exact hpre.elim
  | read _ hs ih => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | pin _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | unpin _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | endUse _ hs ih => exact endUse_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | free _ hs ih => exact free_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih hs
  | alloc hr hs ih => exact alloc_preserves_anchorOrderHeld (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1 ih hs
  | newArena _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | issue _ hs ih =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      cases hst with
      | ok _ _ _ h4 => exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld h4 rfl rfl rfl rfl
  | reset _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split
    · exact sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld ih rfl rfl rfl rfl
    · exact ih
  | store _ hs ih => obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2

/-- The invariant of the reached states extended by G3 and G4 (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3, G3, G4):
`WF3`, `Inv3`, `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (`AnchorOrderHeld`), `NoOrphan`, and
`ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem reachable_access_invariant_ext {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s ∧
      ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar :=
  let h' := reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd h
  ⟨h'.1, h'.2.1, reachable_anchorOrderHeld hdd h, reachable_no_orphan hdd h, h'.2.2⟩

/-- `exitFrame_no_dangling` on reached states (MM-03.3 §4, O7; §10), under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem exitFrame_no_dangling_reachable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {f : Nat}
    {F₀ : Frames} (hs : Reachable k statics s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, OwnedByFrame s.P f q → ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y →
      y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint :=
  exitFrame_no_dangling (reachable_access_invariant_underDD hdd hs).1 hF h

/-! ## Test cases (MM-03.3 §11 and the tasks of passes 2 and 3)

Each verdict is obtained by `decide` on the precondition of the operation concerned. States are
built from `S3.init` by the effects of operations. Classification of each case (kernel,
abstraction with `K` instantiated, out of kernel) is given in the report. -/

/-- Test contracts: `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable` given by lists of
leaves or places, `FreeCompat` by a list of pairs; no declared disjointness; every allocation
satisfiable. -/
def KT (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat)) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ sh), (· ∈ pinned), (· ∈ done), (· ∈ dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ compat, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Every place of a well-formed state has a leaf (MM-03.3.2): its parts have larger indices
(`WF3`), so the search for a part without part terminates. -/
theorem exists_mem_footprint {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n q, s.P.length - q < n → q < s.P.length → ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)

    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall _ hleaf
      have hpr : parentOf s.P r = some q := Decidable.of_not_not hpr

=== def EnterPre 
def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.F ≠ [] ∧
  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True

=== def IssueStatic
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)

=== def Inv3 
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

=== def Inv3base
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

=== def CallProtects
def CallProtects (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : Frames) (f : Nat) (F₀ : Frames), s.F = G ++ f :: F₀ →
    ∀ p ∈ s.callParams f, ∀ y : Authority, s.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify →
      ∀ (b : Nat) (m : Mode), s.ExercisableAt b m → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ s.afp b →
        b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b

=== theorem store_escape_rejected_at_transfer
theorem store_escape_rejected_at_transfer {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst a f g : Nat} {F₀ : Frames}
    {z : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (ha : a ∈ depsOf s src)
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor a]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor a))
    (hzf : s.hframe z.holder = some f)
    (hg : (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst = some g) (hgF : g ∈ F₀) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  refine .reject fun hpre => ?_
  have hdst : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hin : a ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D dst := by
    simp only [transferEff, ↓reduceIte]
    exact List.mem_append_right _ ha
  have hok := hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 dst
    (List.mem_range.2 (by have := hdst.lt; simpa [transferEff] using this)) hdst a hin (.inr (.inl rfl))
  rw [transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm, hg] at hok
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [hz] at hok
  simp only [OptP, hzf] at hok
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  rw [hF] at hok
  unfold ancestor at hok
  have hfg : f ≠ g := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ hgF)
  simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show (f != g) = true by simp [hfg], ↓reduceIte] at hok
  exact hnd.1 (mem_of_mem_dropWhile hok)

=== def AnchorOrder 
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

=== inductive IssueStep
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-! ## Protection of the parameters of a call (F6) -/

/-- `call_protects_params_safe` as stated by F6 and kept by G1, transitive form, as a predicate on a
state: for a stack `G ++ f :: F₀`, the current frame being `f` or a frame called by `f`
transitively, every authority exercisable by the current frame (A2, B2) that covers a leaf of the
footprint of a `Modify` authority of `callParams f` is that authority or one of its descendants,
whether the parameter is active or not. It concerns the safe accesses of the kernel only: neither
raw pointers nor suspension are represented, and no consequence on `noalias` is drawn here (G1:
milestone 2 and the low-level translation). -/
def CallProtects (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : Frames) (f : Nat) (F₀ : Frames), s.F = G ++ f :: F₀ →
    ∀ p ∈ s.callParams f, ∀ y : Authority, s.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify →
      ∀ (b : Nat) (m : Mode), s.ExercisableAt b m → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ s.afp b →
        b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b

/-- The direct form of `CallProtects` (F6): the current frame is `f`. -/
def CallProtectsDirect (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : Nat) (F₀ : Frames), s.F = f :: F₀ →
    ∀ p ∈ s.callParams f, ∀ y : Authority, s.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify →
      ∀ (b : Nat) (m : Mode), s.ExercisableAt b m → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ s.afp b →
        b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b

theorem CallProtects.direct {s : S3} (h : CallProtects s) : CallProtectsDirect s :=
  fun f F₀ hF => h [] f F₀ hF

theorem S3.ExercisableAt.lt {s : S3} {b : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt b m) :
    b < s.A.length := by
  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›

/-- The condition of `CallProtects` for one parameter `p`, read on the authorities of `A` and on
both modes: decidable form. -/
def ParamProtected (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  (s.A[p]?).map (·.mode) = some .modify →
    ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, (s.ExercisableAt b .observe ∨ s.ExercisableAt b .modify) →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp p, l ∈ s.afp b → b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamProtected s p) := by
  unfold ParamProtected; infer_instance

/-- `CallProtects` holds when every parameter of every frame of the stack is protected
(`ParamProtected`): a decidable sufficient condition, used on concrete states. -/
theorem callProtects_of_check {s : S3}
    (hchk : ∀ f ∈ s.F, ∀ p ∈ s.callParams f, ParamProtected s p) : CallProtects s := by
  intro G f F₀ hF p hp y hy hm b m hex l hl hlb
  have hf : f ∈ s.F := by rw [hF]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
  exact hchk f hf p hp (by rw [hy]; simp [hm]) b (List.mem_range.2 hex.lt)
    (by cases m with | observe => exact .inl hex | modify => exact .inr hex) l
    (by simp only [S3.afp, hy]; exact hl) hlb

/-- The part of F6 that holds without hypothesis on the call (MM-03.3.5; I1): while an active
`Modify` authority `p` covers a leaf `l`, every authority with a present effective mode on `l` is
`p` or one of its descendants. It says nothing once `p` is released, nor of authorities that are
exercisable without an effective mode on `l`. -/
theorem call_params_effective_protected {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {p b l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hp : s.A[p]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hm : y.mode = .modify) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint)
    (hb : effective s b l ≠ none) : b = p ∨ p ∈ s.ancs b := by
  by_cases e : b = p
  · exact .inl e
  by_cases hpb : p ∈ s.ancs b
  · exact .inr hpb
  cases he : effective s b l with
  | none => exact absurd he hb
  | some mb =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xl, ex⟩ := effective_some he
    by_cases hbp : b ∈ s.ancs p
    · have hd : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s b l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨p, y, hp, ya, hl, hbp, hm⟩
      rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, -⟩
      · simp [h0] at hd
      · exact absurd hd hn
    · have := (h1 b p x y l e hx hp xa ya xl hl hbp hpb).2
      rw [hm] at this; cases this

/-- `enter_params_protected` (G1): at the entry, the parameters satisfy the clause of G1
(`ParamOriginHidden`) and exclusivity: I1 holds (MM-03.3 §2), and on each leaf of a `Modify`
parameter `p`, every authority with a present effective mode is `p` or one of its descendants
(MM-03.3.5). -/
theorem enter_params_protected {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat}
    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden s' p) ∧ I1 s' ∧
      ∀ p ∈ ps, ∀ y : Authority, s'.A[p]? = some y → y.mode = .modify → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint,
        ∀ b, effective s' b l ≠ none → b = p ∨ p ∈ s'.ancs b := by
  have hi1 := (enter_preserves hwf hinv h).2.1
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨hpre.2.1, hi1, fun p hp y hy hm l hl b hb =>
    call_params_effective_protected hi1 hy ?_ hm hl hb⟩
  have h2 := hpre.1.2.1 p hp
  unfold OptP at h2; split at h2
  · rename_i y₀ hy₀
    rw [enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy₀), hy₀] at hy
    simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy
    subst hy; split <;> exact h2.1
  · exact h2.elim

/-- A witness against `CallProtects` (F6, G1): a `Modify` parameter `p` of the current frame `f`,
and an authority `b`, exercisable at some mode, that covers a leaf of `p` and is neither `p` nor a
descendant of `p`. -/
theorem not_callProtectsDirect {s : S3} {f p b l : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} {m : Mode}
    (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (hp : p ∈ s.callParams f) (hm : (s.A[p]?).map (·.mode) = some .modify)
    (hl : l ∈ s.afp p) (hb : s.ExercisableAt b m) (hlb : l ∈ s.afp b) (hne : b ≠ p)
    (hd : p ∉ s.ancs b) : ¬ CallProtectsDirect s := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hm

theorem not_callProtects {s : S3} {f p b l : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} {m : Mode} (hF : s.F = f :: F₀)
    (hp : p ∈ s.callParams f) (hm : (s.A[p]?).map (·.mode) = some .modify) (hl : l ∈ s.afp p)
    (hb : s.ExercisableAt b m) (hlb : l ∈ s.afp b) (hne : b ≠ p) (hd : p ∉ s.ancs b) :
    ¬ CallProtects s :=
  fun h => not_callProtectsDirect hF hp hm hl hb hlb hne hd h.direct

/-- F6, kept by G1, is still not provable: a counterexample on a reached state, at the entry. G1
constrains the direct origin of a parameter only; here the caller passes a parameter and an
ancestor of its origin. Frame 1: local 0, of root 0; the caller derives 1, `Modify` on 0, then 2
from 1 and 3 from 2, and calls with `[1, 3]`: the origins 0 and 2 are held by frame 1, so the call
is accepted. In frame 2, the parameter 1 is exercisable, covers the leaf 0 of the parameter 3, and
is an ancestor of 3, not a descendant. The failure concerns the statement only: 1 has no
effective mode on 0 while 2 is active, also after the callee releases 3. -/
def gp0 : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) 1 0 .modify) 2 0 .modify
def gp1 : S3 := enterEff gp0 [1, 3] []
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_grand :
    Reachable K0 [] gp1 ∧ EnterStep [1, 3] [] gp0 (.ok gp1) ∧ ¬ CallProtects gp1 ∧
      ReleaseStep 3 gp1 (.ok (releaseEff gp1 3)) ∧ ¬ CallProtects (releaseEff gp1 3) ∧
      effective (releaseEff gp1 3) 1 0 = none := by
  have he : EnterStep [1, 3] [] gp0 (.ok gp1) := .ok (by decide)
  have hr : Reachable K0 [] gp1 := .enter (.derive (.derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) he
  exact ⟨hr, he, not_callProtects (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 3) (b := 1) (l := 0) (m := .modify)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), not_callProtects (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 3) (b := 1) (l := 0)
    (m := .modify) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- F6, kept by G1, is still not provable: a counterexample during the invocation, where the direct
origin of a parameter, exercisable at no mode at the entry, becomes exercisable once the callee
releases two authorities that blocked another parameter, here after the release of the parameter
itself, which only the final write needs (G1, targeted search; the same without releasing the
parameter: `call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock_active`).
Frame 1: `L` (0), `src` (1), a structure `q` (2) with the fields 3 and 4, a structure `w` (5) with
the fields 6 and 7; roots 0, 1, 2 (on 3 and 4) and 3 (on 6 and 7). The caller derives 4, `Modify` on
`L`, stores it into `src` (F4) and transfers `src` into `q`: 4 is held by `q`. It derives 5 from 4
on `L`, 6 from the root 2 on `q`, 7 and 8 from 6 on the fields 3 and 4, 9 from the root 3 on `w`,
stores 7 into 6 and 8 into 7, and calls with `[5, 6, 9]`. At the entry, 4 is exercisable at no
mode: 6 has no effective mode on `q`, and 7 and 8, exercisable through 9, each cover one field of
`q`; the call is accepted (G1) and `CallProtects` holds. The callee releases 5: 4 is still hidden.
It releases 7 and 8, held by the fields of `w` on which 9 gives `Modify` (C4): 6 regains effective
`Modify` on `q`, so 4 is exercisable, covers the leaf 0 of 5, and is its ancestor. The callee then
writes the leaf 0 through 4. -/
def ub0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),
  (some 2, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)]
def ub1 : S3 := deriveEff ub0 0 0 .modify
def ub2 : S3 := storeEff ub1 4 1
def ub3 : S3 := transferEff ub2 1 2
def ub4 : S3 := deriveEff ub3 4 0 .modify
def ub5 : S3 := deriveEff ub4 2 2 .modify
def ub6 : S3 := deriveEff ub5 6 3 .modify
def ub7 : S3 := deriveEff ub6 6 4 .modify
def ub8 : S3 := deriveEff ub7 3 5 .modify
def ub9 : S3 := storeEff ub8 7 6
def ub10 : S3 := storeEff ub9 8 7
def ub11 : S3 := enterEff ub10 [5, 6, 9] []
def ub12 : S3 := releaseEff ub11 5
def ub13 : S3 := releaseEff ub12 7
def ub14 : S3 := releaseEff ub13 8
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock :
    Reachable K0 [] ub14 ∧ EnterStep [5, 6, 9] [] ub10 (.ok ub11) ∧ CallProtects ub11 ∧
      ¬ ub11.ExercisableAt 4 .observe ∧ ¬ ub12.ExercisableAt 4 .observe ∧
      ub14.ExercisableAt 4 .modify ∧ ¬ CallProtects ub14 ∧
      Write3Step 4 [0] ub14 (.ok (write3Eff ub14 [0])) := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] ub0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] ub1 := .derive r0 (show DeriveStep 0 0 .modify ub0 (.ok ub1) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] ub2 := .store r1 (show StoreStep 4 1 ub1 (.ok ub2) from .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] ub3 := .transfer r2 (show TransferStep K0 1 2 ub2 (.ok ub3) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] ub4 := .derive r3 (show DeriveStep 4 0 .modify ub3 (.ok ub4) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] ub5 := .derive r4 (show DeriveStep 2 2 .modify ub4 (.ok ub5) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r6 : Reachable K0 [] ub6 := .derive r5 (show DeriveStep 6 3 .modify ub5 (.ok ub6) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r7 : Reachable K0 [] ub7 := .derive r6 (show DeriveStep 6 4 .modify ub6 (.ok ub7) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r8 : Reachable K0 [] ub8 := .derive r7 (show DeriveStep 3 5 .modify ub7 (.ok ub8) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r9 : Reachable K0 [] ub9 := .store r8 (show StoreStep 7 6 ub8 (.ok ub9) from .ok (by decide))
  have r10 : Reachable K0 [] ub10 := .store r9 (show StoreStep 8 7 ub9 (.ok ub10) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have he : EnterStep [5, 6, 9] [] ub10 (.ok ub11) := .ok (by decide)
  have r12 : Reachable K0 [] ub12 := .release (.enter r10 he)
    (show ReleaseStep 5 ub11 (.ok ub12) from .ok (by decide))
  have r13 : Reachable K0 [] ub13 := .release r12 (show ReleaseStep 7 ub12 (.ok ub13) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r14 : Reachable K0 [] ub14 := .release r13 (show ReleaseStep 8 ub13 (.ok ub14) from
    .ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨r14, he, callProtects_of_check (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide,
    not_callProtects (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 5) (b := 4) (l := 0) (m := .modify)
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `call_protects_params_safe` (F6, kept by G1) is false on the reached states, in its transitive
form and in its direct form: the witness is `ub14` (`call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock`). -/
theorem call_protects_params_safe_false :
    ¬ (∀ s, Reachable K0 [] s → CallProtects s) ∧
      ¬ (∀ s, Reachable K0 [] s → CallProtectsDirect s) := by
  have hd : ¬ CallProtectsDirect ub14 := not_callProtectsDirect (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 5)
    (b := 4) (l := 0) (m := .modify) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hr := call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock.1
  exact ⟨fun h => hd (h _ hr).direct, fun h => hd (h _ hr)⟩

/-- `effOf` depends on the modes of the active covering descendants only through which modes occur
(MM-03.3.5). -/
theorem effOf_congr {m : Mode} {ds ds' : List Mode} (h : ∀ m', m' ∈ ds ↔ m' ∈ ds') :
    effOf m ds = effOf m ds' := by
  unfold effOf
  by_cases h0 : ds = []
  · have h0' : ds' = [] := nil_of_forall_not_mem fun m' hm => by
      have := (h m').2 hm; rw [h0] at this; simp at this
    simp [h0, h0']
  · have h0' : ds' ≠ [] := fun e => h0 (nil_of_forall_not_mem fun m' hm => by
      have := (h m').1 hm; rw [e] at this; simp at this)
    simp only [h0, h0', ↓reduceIte, h .modify]

theorem release_get {s : S3} {p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[p]? = some y) (j : Nat) :
    (releaseEff s p).A[j]? = if p = j then some { y with active := false } else s.A[j]? := by
  rw [releaseEff_eq hy]; exact set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy)

/-- The release of a `Modify` authority `p` whose origin `o` is active changes the effective mode of
no authority other than `p` and `o` (MM-03.3.5; I2): on a leaf of `p`, every strict ancestor of
`o` keeps `o`, active and `Modify`, as a covering descendant. -/
theorem release_effective_other {s : S3} {p o b l : Nat} {y x : Authority} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hi2 : I2 s) (hy : s.A[p]? = some y) (hm : y.mode = .modify) (ho : y.origin = some o)
    (hx : s.A[o]? = some x) (xa : x.active = true) (hbo : b ≠ o) (hbp : b ≠ p) :
    effective (releaseEff s p) b l = effective s b l := by
  have hanc := release_ancs hy
  have hop : o ≠ p := fun e => by
    have := hwf.origin p y o hy ho; omega
  have hpb : p ≠ b := Ne.symm hbp
  unfold effective; rw [release_get hy]; simp only [hpb, ↓reduceIte]
  cases s.A[b]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some xb =>
    simp only
    split
    · apply effOf_congr
      intro m'
      rw [mem_descModes, mem_descModes, hanc]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl, hb, hzm⟩
        rw [release_get hy] at hz
        split at hz
        · cases hz; simp at za
        · exact ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl, hb, hzm⟩
      · rintro ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl, hb, hzm⟩
        by_cases hj : p = j
        · subst hj; rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
          obtain ⟨x', hx', hcov⟩ := hi2 p y o hy ho
          rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
          have hbo' : b ∈ s.ancs o := by
            rw [ancs_cons (x := p) (o := o) hwf.origin (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho])] at hb
            rcases List.mem_cons.1 hb with e | e
            · exact absurd e hbo
            · exact e
          obtain ⟨hlx, hle⟩ := hcov l hl
          have hxm : x.mode = .modify := by
            rcases hle with e | e
            · rw [hm] at e; cases e
            · exact e
          have hpo : p ≠ o := Ne.symm hop
          refine ⟨o, x, by rw [release_get hy]; simp only [hpo, ↓reduceIte]; exact hx, xa, hlx, hbo', ?_⟩
          rw [hxm, ← hzm, hm]
        · exact ⟨j, z, by rw [release_get hy]; simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte]; exact hz, za, hl, hb, hzm⟩
    · rfl

/-- G1, targeted search: the release of a `Modify` authority `p` alone never makes its direct
origin `o` exercisable, at any mode. The release changes the effective mode of no other
authority than `p` and `o` (`release_effective_other`), so an authority exercisable after it was
exercisable before, or its exercise goes through `o` itself (the closure of `ExercisableAt`, B2).
The origin of a parameter can still become exercisable during the call through the release of
other authorities, the parameter being active or not (`call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock`,
`call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock_active`). -/
theorem release_keeps_origin_hidden {s s' : S3} {p o : Nat} {y : Authority} {m : Mode}
    (hwf : WF3 s) (hi2 : I2 s) (hy : s.A[p]? = some y) (hm : y.mode = .modify)
    (ho : y.origin = some o) (hs : ReleaseStep p s (.ok s')) (hn : ¬ s.ExercisableAt o m) :
    ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o m := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  have hop : o ≠ p := fun e => by
    have := hwf.origin p y o hy ho; omega
  have htop : (releaseEff s p).top = s.top := by rw [releaseEff_eq hy]; rfl
  have hP : (releaseEff s p).P = s.P := by rw [releaseEff_eq hy]
  have hpo : p ≠ o := Ne.symm hop
  have hxo : (releaseEff s p).A[o]? = s.A[o]? := by rw [release_get hy]; simp only [hpo, ↓reduceIte]
  cases hx : s.A[o]? with
  | none =>
    intro h; cases h <;> (rename_i hz _ _ _ <;> skip) <;> simp_all
  | some x =>
  by_cases xa : x.active = true
  · have key : ∀ c m', ¬ s.ExercisableAt o m' → (releaseEff s p).ExercisableAt c m' →
        s.ExercisableAt c m' := by
      intro c m' hn' hc
      revert hn'
      induction hc with
      | @base c m' z hz za hle hh =>
        intro _
        rw [release_get hy] at hz
        split at hz
        · cases hz; simp at za
        · exact .base hz za hle (htop ▸ hh)
      | @held c q b m' z hz za hle hh _ hall ih =>
        intro hn'
        rw [release_get hy] at hz
        split at hz
        · cases hz; simp at za
        · have hb := ih hn'
          refine .held hz za hle hh hb fun l hl => ?_
          have h1 := hall l (by rw [hP]; exact hl)
          by_cases hbo : b = o
          · subst hbo; exact absurd hb hn'
          by_cases hbp : b = p
          · subst hbp
            have : effective (releaseEff s b) b l = none := by
              unfold effective; rw [release_get hy]; simp
            rw [this] at h1; exact h1.elim
          · rwa [release_effective_other hwf hi2 hy hm ho hx xa hbo hbp] at h1
    exact fun h => hn (key o m hn h)
  · intro h
    rw [hx] at hxo
    cases h with
    | base hz za _ _ => rw [hxo] at hz; cases hz; exact xa za
    | held hz za _ _ _ _ => rw [hxo] at hz; cases hz; exact xa za

/-- The witness `ub` without the release of the parameter (G1, targeted search): from the entry
`ub11`, the callee releases only 7 and 8; the parameter 5 is still active, and its direct origin 4
is exercisable at `Modify`, without effective mode on the leaf 0 while 5 is active. -/
def ua1 : S3 := releaseEff ub11 7
def ua2 : S3 := releaseEff ua1 8
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock_active :
    Reachable K0 [] ua2 ∧ ReleaseStep 7 ub11 (.ok ua1) ∧ ReleaseStep 8 ua1 (.ok ua2) ∧
      ua2.Active 5 ∧ ua2.ExercisableAt 4 .modify ∧ effective ua2 4 0 = none ∧
      ¬ CallProtects ua2 := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] ub0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] ub1 := .derive r0 (show DeriveStep 0 0 .modify ub0 (.ok ub1) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] ub2 := .store r1 (show StoreStep 4 1 ub1 (.ok ub2) from .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] ub3 := .transfer r2 (show TransferStep K0 1 2 ub2 (.ok ub3) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] ub4 := .derive r3 (show DeriveStep 4 0 .modify ub3 (.ok ub4) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] ub5 := .derive r4 (show DeriveStep 2 2 .modify ub4 (.ok ub5) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r6 : Reachable K0 [] ub6 := .derive r5 (show DeriveStep 6 3 .modify ub5 (.ok ub6) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r7 : Reachable K0 [] ub7 := .derive r6 (show DeriveStep 6 4 .modify ub6 (.ok ub7) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r8 : Reachable K0 [] ub8 := .derive r7 (show DeriveStep 3 5 .modify ub7 (.ok ub8) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r9 : Reachable K0 [] ub9 := .store r8 (show StoreStep 7 6 ub8 (.ok ub9) from .ok (by decide))
  have r10 : Reachable K0 [] ub10 := .store r9 (show StoreStep 8 7 ub9 (.ok ub10) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have he : EnterStep [5, 6, 9] [] ub10 (.ok ub11) := .ok (by decide)
  have h1 : ReleaseStep 7 ub11 (.ok ua1) := .ok (by decide)
  have h2 : ReleaseStep 8 ua1 (.ok ua2) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.release (.release (.enter r10 he) h1) h2, h1, h2, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    not_callProtects (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 5) (b := 4) (l := 0) (m := .modify)
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide)⟩

/-- F6, kept by G1, also fails through the re-anchoring of the exit (O7, A7), which no clause at the
entry constrains: a frame passes its parameter on, the callee derives from it, stores the result
into a place of its caller and returns; the exit releases the forwarded parameter in the callee
and re-attaches the stored authority to the root of the first caller. Back in frame 2, it is
exercisable, covers the leaf of frame 2's parameter 1, and is no longer its descendant, though it
was derived from it. Frame 1: local 0, root 0; it derives 1, `Modify` on 0, and calls with `[1]`;
frame 2 has the local 1, of root 2, derives 3, `Modify` on 1, and calls with `[1, 3]`; frame 3
derives 4 from 1 on 0, stores it into 1 and exits. Frame 2 then writes the leaf 0 through 4. -/
def xr0 : S3 := deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify
def xr1 : S3 := enterEff xr0 [1] [(none, none, 0)]
def xr2 : S3 := deriveEff xr1 2 1 .modify
def xr3 : S3 := enterEff xr2 [1, 3] []
def xr4 : S3 := deriveEff xr3 1 0 .modify
def xr5 : S3 := storeEff xr4 4 1
def xr6 : S3 := exitEff xr5
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_exit :
    Reachable K0 [] xr6 ∧ xr6.F = [2, 1, 0] ∧ xr6.callParams 2 = [1] ∧ xr6.ancs 4 = [0] ∧
      ¬ CallProtects xr6 ∧ ¬ CallProtectsDirect xr6 ∧
      Write3Step 4 [0] xr6 (.ok (write3Eff xr6 [0])) := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] xr0 :=
    .derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] xr1 := .enter r0 (show EnterStep [1] [(none, none, 0)] xr0 (.ok xr1) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] xr2 := .derive r1 (show DeriveStep 2 1 .modify xr1 (.ok xr2) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] xr3 := .enter r2 (show EnterStep [1, 3] [] xr2 (.ok xr3) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] xr4 := .derive r3 (show DeriveStep 1 0 .modify xr3 (.ok xr4) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] xr5 := .store r4 (show StoreStep 4 1 xr4 (.ok xr5) from .ok (by decide))
  have r6 : Reachable K0 [] xr6 := .exit r5 (show ExitStep K0 xr5 (.ok xr6) from .ok (by decide))
  have hd : ¬ CallProtectsDirect xr6 := not_callProtectsDirect (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 1)
    (b := 4) (l := 0) (m := .modify) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  exact ⟨r6, by decide, by decide, by decide, fun h => hd h.direct, hd, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- The same where every parameter is derived by its caller (A3 read strictly): frame 2 stores its
parameter 1 into the place 2 it owns through the local 1, derives 5, `Modify` on 1, and 6, `Modify`
on the local 3, and calls with `[5, 6]` and a local 4; frame 3 transfers 2 into 4, derives 8 from
1 on 0, stores 8 into 3 and exits. The exit releases 1, held within frame 3, and re-attaches 8 to
the root 0 of frame 1. -/
def yr0 : S3 := deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify
def yr1 : S3 := enterEff yr0 [1] [(none, none, 0), (none, some 1, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def yr2 : S3 := storeEff yr1 1 2
def yr3 : S3 := deriveEff yr2 2 1 .modify
def yr4 : S3 := deriveEff yr3 4 3 .modify
def yr5 : S3 := enterEff yr4 [5, 6] [(none, none, 0)]
def yr6 : S3 := transferEff yr5 2 4
def yr7 : S3 := deriveEff yr6 1 0 .modify
def yr8 : S3 := storeEff yr7 8 3
def yr9 : S3 := exitEff yr8
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_exit_strict :
    Reachable K0 [] yr9 ∧ yr9.callParams 2 = [1] ∧ ¬ yr9.Active 1 ∧ yr9.ancs 8 = [0] ∧
      ¬ CallProtects yr9 ∧ Write3Step 8 [0] yr9 (.ok (write3Eff yr9 [0])) := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] yr0 :=
    .derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] yr1 := .enter r0 (show EnterStep [1] [(none, none, 0), (none, some 1, 0),
    (none, none, 0)] yr0 (.ok yr1) from .ok (by decide))
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] yr2 := .store r1 (show StoreStep 1 2 yr1 (.ok yr2) from .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] yr3 := .derive r2 (show DeriveStep 2 1 .modify yr2 (.ok yr3) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] yr4 := .derive r3 (show DeriveStep 4 3 .modify yr3 (.ok yr4) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] yr5 := .enter r4 (show EnterStep [5, 6] [(none, none, 0)] yr4 (.ok yr5) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r6 : Reachable K0 [] yr6 := .transfer r5 (show TransferStep K0 2 4 yr5 (.ok yr6) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r7 : Reachable K0 [] yr7 := .derive r6 (show DeriveStep 1 0 .modify yr6 (.ok yr7) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r8 : Reachable K0 [] yr8 := .store r7 (show StoreStep 8 3 yr7 (.ok yr8) from .ok (by decide))
  have r9 : Reachable K0 [] yr9 := .exit r8 (show ExitStep K0 yr8 (.ok yr9) from .ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨r9, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    not_callProtects (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 1) (b := 8) (l := 0) (m := .modify)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- The pass-6 counterexample to F6 where the caller passes an authority and one of its
descendants, now rejected at `enterFrame` by G1. Frame 1: local 0, of root 0; the caller derives 1,
`Modify` on 0, then 2, `Modify` on 0 from 1, and calls with `[1, 2]`: in the state where the new
frame holds its parameters, the parameter 1, origin of the parameter 2, is exercisable, so the
call is rejected (G1). The state `cp1` the call would produce, no longer reached, still violates
`CallProtects`: there, the parameter 1 is exercisable, covers the leaf 0 of the parameter 2, and is
its ancestor; after the callee releases 2, it writes the leaf 0 through 1. -/
def cp0 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) 1 0 .modify
def cp1 : S3 := enterEff cp0 [1, 2] []
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_param :
    Reachable K0 [] cp0 ∧ EnterStep [1, 2] [] cp0 .reject ∧ ¬ CallProtects cp1 ∧
      ReleaseStep 2 cp1 (.ok (releaseEff cp1 2)) ∧ ¬ CallProtects (releaseEff cp1 2) ∧
      Write3Step 1 [0] (releaseEff cp1 2) (.ok (write3Eff (releaseEff cp1 2) [0])) := by
  have hr : Reachable K0 [] cp0 := .derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have key : ∀ s : S3, s.F = [2, 1, 0] → s.callParams 2 = [1, 2] → s.ExercisableAt 1 .modify →
      (s.A[2]?).map (fun y => (y.mode, y.footprint)) = some (.modify, [0]) → s.afp 1 = [0] →
      s.ancs 1 = [0] → ¬ CallProtects s := by
    intro s hF hc hex h2 h1 ha h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h2
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at e
    have := h.direct 2 [1, 0] hF 2 (by rw [hc]; decide) y hy e.1 1 .modify hex 0 (by rw [e.2]; decide)
      (by rw [h1]; decide)
    rw [ha] at this; simp at this
  exact ⟨hr, .reject (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- The pass-6 counterexample to F6 through owned storage (A5; A2, held authorities), now
rejected at `enterFrame` by G1. Frame 1: value 0, of root 0 held by frame 1, which owns the storage
1, of root 1 held by the place 0. The caller derives 2, `Modify` on 1 from the root 1, and 3,
`Modify` on 0, and calls with `[2, 3]`: in the state where the new frame holds its parameters, the
root 1, origin of the parameter 2, is exercisable through the parameter 3, so the call is
rejected (G1). The state `co1` the call would produce, no longer reached, still violates
`CallProtects`; after the callee releases 2, it writes the leaf 1 through the root 1. -/
def co0 : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0)]) 1 1 .modify) 0 0 .modify
def co1 : S3 := enterEff co0 [2, 3] []
theorem call_protects_params_safe_fails_owned :
    Reachable K0 [] co0 ∧ EnterStep [2, 3] [] co0 .reject ∧ ¬ CallProtects co1 ∧
      ReleaseStep 2 co1 (.ok (releaseEff co1 2)) ∧ ¬ CallProtects (releaseEff co1 2) ∧
      Write3Step 1 [1] (releaseEff co1 2) (.ok (write3Eff (releaseEff co1 2) [1])) := by
  have hr : Reachable K0 [] co0 := .derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have key : ∀ s : S3, s.F = [2, 1, 0] → s.callParams 2 = [2, 3] → s.ExercisableAt 1 .modify →
      (s.A[2]?).map (fun y => (y.mode, y.footprint)) = some (.modify, [1]) → s.afp 1 = [1] →
      s.ancs 1 = [] → ¬ CallProtects s := by
    intro s hF hc hex h2 h1 ha h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h2
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at e
    have := h.direct 2 [1, 0] hF 2 (by rw [hc]; decide) y hy e.1 1 .modify hex 1 (by rw [e.2]; decide)
      (by rw [h1]; decide)
    rw [ha] at this; simp at this
  exact ⟨hr, .reject (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide), key _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ### Nested arena with a child value (F1) -/

/-- An arena nested in a block issued to a value distinct from the parent arena value (F1: the
child arena value is the holder of its `internal`, the block). Frame 1: 0 parent arena value,
1 allocator value, 2 child arena value; storage 3 with parts 4 and 5, owned by 0, of root 3; the
parent issues the block 4 on `[4]` to 2; `newArena 4 4` registers the child on the part 4. The
`reset` of the parent is rejected while the child lives (expected: reject); after the `endUse` of
the child value, which releases the block, it is accepted (expected: `ok`). -/
def na0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def na1 : S3 :=
  allocEff (write3Eff na0 [1]) 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)]
def na2 : S3 := newArenaEff na1 3 3
def arNa : Arena := ⟨3, 3, [4, 5], []⟩
def na3 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff na2 arNa [4] 2).1 0 (issueEff na2 arNa [4] 2).2
def na4 : S3 := newArenaEff na3 4 4

    (by decide) rfl rfl, hr, hs, .store (.release r1 hr) hs⟩

/-! ### Progress (F7; G2) -/

/-- A cycle of three authorities on three nodes (F7; G2). Frame 1: 0 arena value, 1 allocator
value, 2, 3 and 4 node values; storage 5 with the nodes 6 (A), 7 (B) and 8 (C), owned by 0, of
root 5; `newArena 5 5`; the blocks 6, 7 and 8 on the nodes are issued to 2, 3 and 4. The frame
derives 9, `Modify` on B from the block 7, stores it into A; 10, `Modify` on C from the block 8,
stores it into B; 11, `Modify` on A from the block 6, and stores it into C: the last `store` is
rejected (expected and obtained), by the clause of arrival of G2: the only authority with an
effective mode on C would be 10, held by B, on which only 9 has one, held by A, on which only 11 has
one, held by C. In the sense of `CoversHolder` (G3), C stays covered by `internal` 5 and by its
block 8, which have no effective mode there. The same cycle is reached with a helper released
after the stores (`f7a_cycle_by_release`, `cycle_by_release`). -/
def tc0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]
def tc1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff tc0 [1]) 1 0
  [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)]
def tc2 : S3 := newArenaEff tc1 5 5
def arTc : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [6, 7, 8], []⟩
def tc3 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff tc2 arTc [6] 2).1 0 (issueEff tc2 arTc [6] 2).2
def arTc' : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [7, 8], [([6], 6)]⟩
def tc4 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff tc3 arTc' [7] 3).1 0 (issueEff tc3 arTc' [7] 3).2
def arTc'' : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [8], [([7], 7), ([6], 6)]⟩
def tc5 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff tc4 arTc'' [8] 4).1 0 (issueEff tc4 arTc'' [8] 4).2
def tc6 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff tc5 7 7 .modify) 9 6
def tc7 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff tc6 8 8 .modify) 10 7
def tc8 : S3 := deriveEff tc7 6 6 .modify
theorem progress_cycle_three_nodes :
    Reachable K0 [] tc8 ∧ StoreStep 9 6 (deriveEff tc5 7 7 .modify) (.ok tc6) ∧
      StoreStep 10 7 (deriveEff tc6 8 8 .modify) (.ok tc7) ∧ StoreStep 11 8 tc8 .reject ∧
      ¬ HasRight (storeEff tc8 11 8) .modify 8 := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] tc0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] tc1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] tc0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 1 0
      [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)] _ (.ok tc1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] tc2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 5 5 tc1 (.ok tc2) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] tc3 := .issue r2 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 2 tc2 (.ok tc3) from
    .ok (ar := arTc) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] tc4 := .issue r3 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [7] 3 tc3 (.ok tc4) from
    .ok (ar := arTc') (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] tc5 := .issue r4 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [8] 4 tc4 (.ok tc5) from
    .ok (ar := arTc'') (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have s6 : StoreStep 9 6 (deriveEff tc5 7 7 .modify) (.ok tc6) := .ok (by decide)
  have s7 : StoreStep 10 7 (deriveEff tc6 8 8 .modify) (.ok tc7) := .ok (by decide)
  have r8 : Reachable K0 [] tc8 := .derive (.store (.derive (.store (.derive r5
    (.ok (by decide))) s6) (.ok (by decide))) s7) (.ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨r8, s6, s7, .reject (by decide), by decide⟩

/-! ### Transfer and issue towards the caller (G4) -/

/-- Twin of `lb5_escape_rejected` (G4): the arena of case 16, whose storage is owned by the
caller's value 0; the callee issues the block 7 to its local 6, then transfers 6 to the caller's
buffer 2 and exits (expected and obtained: `ok` at each step). -/
theorem lb5_twin : TransferStep KA 6 2 a7 (.ok a8) ∧ ExitStep KA a8 (.ok a9) ∧ Reachable KA [] a11 :=
  ⟨.ok (by decide), .ok (by decide), case16_reachable.1⟩

/-- `issue` of a block of the callee's local arena to a value of the caller (G4). Frame 1: 0 the
result; it derives 1, `Modify` on 0, and calls with `[1]`. Frame 2: 1 arena value, 2 allocator
value, 3 a local; `alloc` gives the storage 4, with the part 5, owned by 1, of root 5;
`newArena 4 5`. The `issue` of `[5]` to the caller's value 0 is rejected (expected and
obtained: reject) by the clause of arrival of G4 alone: the block would be held by a place of
frame 1, its effective anchor, the root 5, being of frame 2. The same `issue` to the local 3 is
accepted (twin, `ok`). -/
def ci0 : S3 := enterEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) [1]
  [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def ci1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff ci0 [2]) 2 1 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
def ci2 : S3 := newArenaEff ci1 4 5
def arCi : Arena := ⟨4, 5, [5], []⟩
theorem callee_issue_to_caller :
    Reachable K0 [] ci2 ∧ ci2.arenas = [arCi] ∧ IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 0 ci2 .reject ∧
      IssueStatic K0 ci2 arCi 0 [5] 0 ∧ Avail arCi [5] ∧ IssueRight ci2 arCi [5] ∧
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff ci2 arCi [5] 0).1 ∧
      IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 3 ci2 (.ok (arenaSet (issueEff ci2 arCi [5] 3).1 0
        (issueEff ci2 arCi [5] 3).2)) := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] ci0 := .enter (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] ci1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 3 [2] ci0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 2 1 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)] _ (.ok ci1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] ci2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 4 5 ci1 (.ok ci2) from
    .ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨r2, by decide, .reject (ar := arCi) (by decide)
    (.noAnchor (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)), by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, .ok (ar := arCi) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))⟩

/-- G4 is checked on the arrival state of an `issue` that succeeds only (MM-03.3 §6; A10): after
the block on `[5]` is issued to the local 3, the same `issue` to the caller's value 0 finds the
region unavailable and fails, the state unchanged, as in pass 6, although its arrival state would
break `AnchorOrderHeld`. -/
def ci3 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff ci2 arCi [5] 3).1 0 (issueEff ci2 arCi [5] 3).2
theorem callee_issue_unavailable_fails :
    Reachable K0 [] ci3 ∧ IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 0 ci3 (.fail ci3) := by
  have r2 := callee_issue_to_caller.1
  exact ⟨.issue r2 callee_issue_to_caller.2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
    .fail (ar := (issueEff ci2 arCi [5] 3).2) (by decide) (.fail (by decide) (by decide))⟩

/-! ### Held authorities that no frame can exercise (G3) -/

/-- `NoOrphan` (G3) holds on every reached state, but it does not make a held authority
exercisable: `transfer` builds an active authority held by the place it covers, which no frame
can exercise. Frame 1: structure 0 with the field 1, leaf 2; roots 0 (on 1) and 1 (on 2). The frame
derives 2, `Modify` on 2, stores it into the field 1 (`ok`), then transfers 0 into 2 (`ok`): 2 is
now held by the place 2 that it covers. Its origin, the root 1, has no effective mode on 2, so
2 is exercisable at no mode, the frame has no `Modify` on the place 2, and `release` of 2 and
`endUse` of 2 are rejected; the exit of frame 1 releases 2. The chain of G3 is the root 1, held by
frame 1, then 2. -/
def hu0 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, none, 0)])
  1 2 .modify) 2 1
def hu1 : S3 := transferEff hu0 0 2
theorem held_unexercisable_by_transfer :
    Reachable K0 [] hu1 ∧ (hu1.A[2]?).map (fun y => (y.active, y.holder, y.footprint)) =
      some (true, .place 2, [2]) ∧ ¬ hu1.ExercisableAt 2 .observe ∧ ¬ HasRight hu1 .modify 2 ∧
      ReleaseStep 2 hu1 .reject ∧ EndUseStep K0 2 hu1 .reject ∧ NoOrphan hu1 ∧
      ExitStep K0 hu1 (.ok (exitEff hu1)) ∧ ¬ (exitEff hu1).Active 2 := by
  have r : Reachable K0 [] hu1 := .transfer (.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨r, by decide, by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) r, .ok (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- The same through `issue` (G3; A10): from `fa2` (arena value 0, storage 4 with the nodes 5 and
6, `internal` 4 held by 0), the block on the node 5 is issued to the node 5 itself (`ok`): the block
is held by the place it covers, its origin `internal` 4 has no effective mode there, and the
block is exercisable at no mode. -/
def iu1 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff fa2 arFa [5] 5).1 0 (issueEff fa2 arFa [5] 5).2
theorem held_unexercisable_by_issue :
    Reachable K0 [] iu1 ∧ (iu1.A[5]?).map (fun y => (y.active, y.holder, y.footprint)) =
      some (true, .place 5, [5]) ∧ ¬ iu1.ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧ NoOrphan iu1 := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] fa0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] fa1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] fa0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
      _ (.ok fa1) from .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] fa2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 4 4 fa1 (.ok fa2) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r : Reachable K0 [] iu1 := .issue r2 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 5 fa2 (.ok iu1) from
    .ok (ar := arFa) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  exact ⟨r, by decide, by decide, reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) r⟩

/-! ### Leaves made `Init` without a write (G2; review of pass 7) -/

/-- G2 rejects a `store` into a whole structure, but `transfer` reaches the same configuration
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.2: « La destination peut recevoir la valeur et ses autorités » is read since pass 1
as a usable destination without `Init` leaf, disjoint from the source; nothing relates the shapes
of source and destination). Frame 1: structure 0 with the fields 1 (`ptr`) and 2 (`length`), the
buffer 3, a leaf 4. The frame derives 3, `Modify` on 3, stores it into the leaf 4, then transfers
4 into the structure 0: every leaf of 0 becomes `Init`, `length` included, never written, and 3
is held by the whole structure. -/
def tw0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]
def tw1 : S3 := deriveEff tw0 1 3 .modify
def tw2 : S3 := storeEff tw1 3 4
def tw3 : S3 := transferEff tw2 4 0
theorem transfer_inits_unwritten_after_store :
    Reachable K0 [] tw3 ∧ StoreStep 3 0 tw1 .reject ∧ tw2.I 2 = .uninit ∧ tw3.I 2 = .init ∧
      Read3Step 0 [2] tw3 (.ok tw3) ∧ (tw3.A[3]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 0) := by
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] tw1 := .derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] tw2 := .store r1 (show StoreStep 3 4 tw1 (.ok tw2) from .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] tw3 := .transfer r2 (show TransferStep K0 4 0 tw2 (.ok tw3) from
    .ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨r3, .reject (by decide), by decide, by decide, .ok (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- The same without `store` (MM-03.3 §3, O4.2; MM-03.3.3): frame 1 has the leaf 0 and the
structure 1 with the fields 2 and 3. The frame writes 0 and transfers it into 1: the field 3,
never written, becomes `Init` and is read. -/
def vt0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0)]
def vt1 : S3 := write3Eff vt0 [0]
def vt2 : S3 := transferEff vt1 0 1
theorem transfer_inits_unwritten :
    Reachable K0 [] vt2 ∧ vt1.I 3 = .uninit ∧ Read3Step 1 [3] vt1 .reject ∧
      Read3Step 1 [3] vt2 (.ok vt2) := by
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] vt1 := .write (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (show Write3Step 0 [0] vt0 (.ok vt1) from .ok (by decide))
  exact ⟨.transfer r1 (.ok (by decide)), by decide, .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `issue` into a whole structure (MM-03.3 §6; A10): the block is held by the structure, all its
leaves become `Init`, `length` included, never written, and so does the arena value, whose
metadata `issue` updates (A10). Frame 1: 0 arena value, 1 allocator value, 2 a structure with the
fields 3 (`ptr`) and 4 (`length`); `alloc` gives the storage 5 with the part 6, owned by 0, of root
3; `newArena 5 3`; the block on `[6]` is issued to 2. -/
def it0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),
  (some 2, none, 0)]
def it1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff it0 [1]) 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)]
def it2 : S3 := newArenaEff it1 5 3
def arIt : Arena := ⟨5, 3, [6], []⟩
def it3 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff it2 arIt [6] 2).1 0 (issueEff it2 arIt [6] 2).2
theorem issue_inits_unwritten :
    Reachable K0 [] it3 ∧ it2.I 4 = .uninit ∧ it2.I 0 = .uninit ∧
      Read3Step 2 [4] it2 .reject ∧ Read3Step 2 [4] it3 (.ok it3) ∧
      Read3Step 0 [0] it2 .reject ∧ Read3Step 0 [0] it3 (.ok it3) ∧
      (it3.A[4]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] it0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] it1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] it0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)] _ (.ok it1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] it2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 5 3 it1 (.ok it2) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] it3 := .issue r2 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 2 it2 (.ok it3) from
    .ok (ar := arIt) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  exact ⟨r3, by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), by decide⟩

def NothingAtFrame0 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.holder ≠ .frame 0) True

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NothingAtFrame0 s) := by unfold NothingAtFrame0; infer_instance

/-- The clause of arrival of G2 guards `store` only: the cycle of F7 (a), rejected at the second
`store` (`progress_cycle_whole_nodes`), is built anyway with a helper. From `fa7`, the frame derives
9, `Modify` on B from 7; `store 8 6` is then accepted, the helper keeping B exercisable; `release 9`
closes the cycle. The authorities 7 and 8 are then as after the rejected store: no frame can
exercise them nor observe A or B, while `NoOrphan` holds (G3). -/
def fh0 : S3 := deriveEff fa7 7 6 .modify
def fh1 : S3 := storeEff fh0 8 6
def fh2 : S3 := releaseEff fh1 9
theorem f7a_cycle_by_release :
    Reachable K0 [] fh2 ∧ StoreStep 8 6 fa7 .reject ∧
      StoreStep 8 6 fh0 (.ok fh1) ∧ ReleaseStep 9 fh1 (.ok fh2) ∧
      fh1.ExercisableAt 7 .modify ∧ fh1.ExercisableAt 8 .modify ∧
      (fh2.A[7]?, fh2.A[8]?) = ((storeEff fa7 8 6).A[7]?, (storeEff fa7 8 6).A[8]?) ∧
      ¬ fh2.ExercisableAt 7 .observe ∧ ¬ fh2.ExercisableAt 8 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight fh2 .observe 5 ∧ ¬ HasRight fh2 .observe 6 ∧
      fh2.F = [1, 0] ∧ NothingAtFrame0 fh2 ∧ NoOrphan fh2 := by
  have r7 : Reachable K0 [] fa7 := progress_cycle_whole_nodes.1
  have d : DeriveStep 7 6 .modify fa7 (.ok fh0) := .ok (by decide)
  have st : StoreStep 8 6 fh0 (.ok fh1) := .ok (by decide)
  have rl : ReleaseStep 9 fh1 (.ok fh2) := .ok (by decide)
  have r : Reachable K0 [] fh2 := .release (.store (.derive r7 d) st) rl
  exact ⟨r, progress_cycle_whole_nodes.2.2.2.1, st, rl, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) r⟩

/-- The same pattern on two leaves of the frame (G2): frame 1 has the leaves 0, 1 and 2, of roots
0, 1 and 2. It derives 3, `Modify` on 1, and stores it into 0; derives the helper 4, `Modify` on 1
from 3, then 5, `Modify` on 0, and stores 5 into 1, which the helper makes acceptable; without the
helper, that store is rejected. -/
def eu0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def eu1 : S3 := deriveEff eu0 1 1 .modify
def eu2 : S3 := storeEff eu1 3 0
def eu3 : S3 := deriveEff eu2 3 1 .modify
def eu4 : S3 := deriveEff eu3 0 0 .modify
def eu5 : S3 := storeEff eu4 5 1
theorem eu5_reachable : Reachable K0 [] eu5 ∧ StoreStep 5 1 eu4 (.ok eu5) ∧
    StoreStep 4 1 (deriveEff eu2 0 0 .modify) .reject ∧
    eu5.ExercisableAt 3 .modify ∧ eu5.ExercisableAt 5 .modify := by
  have st : StoreStep 5 1 eu4 (.ok eu5) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.store (.derive (.derive (.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) st, st,
    .reject (by decide), by decide, by decide⟩

/-- `release` of the helper closes the cycle (G2, G3): 3 and 5 are exercisable at no mode and the
frame observes neither 0 nor 1. -/
theorem cycle_by_release :
    ReleaseStep 4 eu5 (.ok (releaseEff eu5 4)) ∧ Reachable K0 [] (releaseEff eu5 4) ∧
      ¬ (releaseEff eu5 4).ExercisableAt 3 .observe ∧
      ¬ (releaseEff eu5 4).ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight (releaseEff eu5 4) .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight (releaseEff eu5 4) .observe 1 ∧
      NothingAtFrame0 (releaseEff eu5 4) := by
  have rl : ReleaseStep 4 eu5 (.ok (releaseEff eu5 4)) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨rl, .release eu5_reachable.1 rl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- `endUse` closes the cycle (G2, G3; A6): the helper is stored into the leaf 2 (`ok`), whose
`endUse` releases it (`ok`); afterwards `release` of 3 and 5 and `endUse` of 0 and 1 are
rejected. -/
def eu6 : S3 := storeEff eu5 4 2
def eu7 : S3 := endUseEff eu6 2
theorem cycle_by_endUse :
    StoreStep 4 2 eu5 (.ok eu6) ∧ EndUseStep K0 2 eu6 (.ok eu7) ∧ Reachable K0 [] eu7 ∧
      eu6.ExercisableAt 3 .modify ∧ eu6.ExercisableAt 5 .modify ∧
      ¬ eu7.ExercisableAt 3 .observe ∧ ¬ eu7.ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight eu7 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight eu7 .observe 1 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 eu7 ∧
      ReleaseStep 3 eu7 .reject ∧ ReleaseStep 5 eu7 .reject ∧
      EndUseStep K0 0 eu7 .reject ∧ EndUseStep K0 1 eu7 .reject := by
  have st : StoreStep 4 2 eu5 (.ok eu6) := .ok (by decide)
  have eu : EndUseStep K0 2 eu6 (.ok eu7) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨st, eu, .endUse (.store eu5_reachable.1 st) eu, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide)⟩

/-- The exit closes the cycle (G2, G3; O7, A7): from `dl1` (parameters 2 on 0 and 3 on 1), the
callee derives 4, `Modify` on 1 from 3, and stores it into 0; derives the helper 5 from 4 and 6,
`Modify` on 0 from 2, and stores 6 into 1; it exits, which releases the helper and re-attaches 4
and 6 to the caller's roots 1 and 0. In the caller, 4 and 6 are exercisable at no mode and the
leaves 0 and 1 cannot be observed. -/
def ex2 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff dl1 3 1 .modify) 4 0
def ex3 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff ex2 4 1 .modify) 2 0 .modify
def ex4 : S3 := storeEff ex3 6 1
def ex5 : S3 := exitEff ex4
theorem cycle_by_exit :
    Reachable K0 [] ex4 ∧ ExitStep K0 ex4 (.ok ex5) ∧ Reachable K0 [] ex5 ∧
      ex4.ExercisableAt 4 .modify ∧ ex4.ExercisableAt 6 .modify ∧
      ex5.F = [1, 0] ∧ ex5.org 4 = some 1 ∧ ex5.org 6 = some 0 ∧
      ¬ ex5.ExercisableAt 4 .observe ∧ ¬ ex5.ExercisableAt 6 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 1 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 ex5 ∧
      NoOrphan ex5 := by
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] dl1 := call_params_distinct_locals.1
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] ex2 := .store (.derive r1 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] ex3 := .derive (.derive r2 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] ex4 := .store r3 (.ok (by decide))
  have ex : ExitStep K0 ex4 (.ok ex5) := .ok (by decide)
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] ex5 := .exit r4 ex
  exact ⟨r4, ex, r5, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) r5⟩

/-- `free` closes the cycle (G2, G3; A6): frame 1 has the leaves 0, 1, the allocator value 2 and
the owner value 3; `alloc` gives the storage 4 owned by 3, of root 4. The frame builds the cycle on
0 and 1 with a helper, stores the helper into the storage 4 and frees 4 (contract `KFr`, under
which 4 is deallocable). -/
abbrev KFr : K := KT [] [] [] [4] [(4, 4)]
def fr0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def fr1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff fr0 [2]) 2 3 [(none, none, 0)]
def fr2 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff fr1 1 1 .modify) 5 0
def fr3 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff fr2 5 1 .modify) 0 0 .modify
def fr4 : S3 := storeEff fr3 7 1
def fr5 : S3 := storeEff fr4 6 4
def fr6 : S3 := freeEff fr5 4
theorem cycle_by_free :
    Reachable KFr [] fr5 ∧ FreeStep KFr 4 4 fr5 (.ok fr6) ∧ Reachable KFr [] fr6 ∧
      fr5.ExercisableAt 5 .modify ∧ fr5.ExercisableAt 7 .modify ∧
      ¬ fr6.ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧ ¬ fr6.ExercisableAt 7 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight fr6 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight fr6 .observe 1 ∧ NoOrphan fr6 := by
  have r0 : Reachable KFr [] fr0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable KFr [] fr1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 2 [2] fr0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep KFr 2 3 [(none, none, 0)] _ (.ok fr1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable KFr [] fr2 := .store (.derive r1 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable KFr [] fr3 := .derive (.derive r2 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r5 : Reachable KFr [] fr5 := .store (.store r3 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have fs : FreeStep KFr 4 4 fr5 (.ok fr6) := .ok (by decide)
  have r6 : Reachable KFr [] fr6 := .free r5 fs
  exact ⟨r5, fs, r6, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [4] [(4, 4)]) r6⟩

/-- Passing the helper of `eu5` as a parameter is rejected by G1: its origin 3 is exercisable
once the new frame holds the helper, which covers the holder 1 of 5, and 5 covers the holder 0 of
3. -/
theorem enter_helper_rejected :
    EnterStep [4] [] eu5 .reject ∧ ¬ ParamOriginHidden (enterEff eu5 [4] []) 4 :=
  ⟨.reject (by decide), by decide⟩

/-! ### `NoOrphan` with effective coverage (G3; review of pass 7) -/

/-- The place of a holder, if it is a place. -/
def holderPlace : Holder → Option Nat
  | .place q => some q
  | .frame _ => none

/-- The frame of a holder, if it is a frame. -/
def holderFrame : Holder → Option Nat
  | .frame f => some f
  | .place _ => none

/-- Another reading of a link of G3, not the module's: `a` is active and has a present effective
mode (MM-03.3.5) on every leaf of the place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolderEff (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => OptP (holderPlace z.holder)
    (fun q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, effective s a l ≠ none) False) False

instance (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (CoversHolderEff s a b) := by
  unfold CoversHolderEff; infer_instance

/-- `NoOrphan` read with effective coverage (`CoversHolderEff`), everything else as in G3. -/
def NoOrphanEff (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolderEff s) (a₀ :: c)

theorem linked_closed {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {S : Nat → Prop} (hR : ∀ a b, S a → R a b → S b) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), Linked R (a :: l) → S a →
      ∀ x, (a :: l).getLast? = some x → S x
  | [], a, _, ha, x, h => by
    simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact ha
  | b :: l, a, h, ha, x, hx =>
    linked_closed hR l b h.2 (hR a b ha h.1) x (by rw [getLast?_cons_ne (by simp)] at hx; exact hx)

/-- A list `S` of authorities that contains every active authority held by a frame of the stack
and is closed under `CoversHolderEff` refutes `NoOrphanEff` if it misses an active authority held
by a place. -/
theorem not_noOrphanEff (s : S3) (S : List Nat)
    (h0 : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true →
      OptP (holderFrame z.holder) (fun f => f ∈ s.F → a ∈ S) True) True)
    (h1 : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, CoversHolderEff s a b → b ∈ S)
    (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat) (hx : s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true)
    (hh : y.holder = .place q) (hxS : x ∉ S) : ¬ NoOrphanEff s := by
  intro hno
  obtain ⟨a₀, z, f, c, hz, za, zh, hf, -, hlast, hlink⟩ := hno x y q hx ya hh
  have ha0 : a₀ ∈ S := by
    have := h0 a₀ (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    simp only [OptP, hz, za, zh, holderFrame, forall_const] at this
    exact this hf
  refine hxS (linked_closed (S := (· ∈ S)) (fun a b ha hab => ?_) c a₀ hlink ha0 x hlast)
  have hb : b < s.A.length := by
    unfold CoversHolderEff OptP at hab
    split at hab
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · exact hab.elim
  exact h1 a ha b (List.mem_range.2 hb) hab

/-- With effective coverage, G3 would be false on reached states (G3): in `hu1` and `iu1`,
`NoOrphan` holds but `NoOrphanEff` does not. -/
theorem noOrphanEff_fails :
    Reachable K0 [] hu1 ∧ NoOrphan hu1 ∧ ¬ NoOrphanEff hu1 ∧
      Reachable K0 [] iu1 ∧ NoOrphan iu1 ∧ ¬ NoOrphanEff iu1 := by
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, -, -, -, hn, -⟩ := held_unexercisable_by_transfer
  obtain ⟨r', -, -, hn'⟩ := held_unexercisable_by_issue
  exact ⟨r, hn, not_noOrphanEff hu1 [0, 1] (by decide) (by decide) 2
    ⟨.modify, some 1, [2], .place 2, true⟩ 2 (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide), r', hn',
    not_noOrphanEff iu1 [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] (by decide) (by decide) 5
    ⟨.modify, some 4, [5], .place 5, true⟩ 5 (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide)⟩

## (d) Demandes non réalisées telles qu'écrites, et pourquoi

1. **`call_protects_params_safe` (F6)** est faux sur des états atteints (`call_protects_params_safe_fails_param`, `call_protects_params_safe_fails_owned`). La tâche dit que « la preuve découle des règles existantes (A2, O3.2) ». Ces deux règles autorisent les deux situations suivantes.
   - *Un paramètre ancêtre d'un autre.*
     - L'appelant dérive 1 (`Modify` sur son local 0), puis 2 de 1 (`Modify` sur 0), et passe `[1, 2]`.
     - Dans l'appelé, 1 est exerçable (A3 en fait le détenteur), couvre la feuille 0 de 2, et en est l'ancêtre.
     - Après `release 2` (O3 : 2 n'a pas de descendant actif), l'appelé écrit la feuille 0 par 1.
   - *Une racine possédée.*
     - L'appelant a une valeur 0 qui possède le stockage 1, de racine 1 détenue par 0 (A4, A5).
     - Il dérive 2 (`Modify` sur 1) de la racine 1 et 3 (`Modify` sur 0), et passe `[2, 3]`.
     - Dans l'appelé, la racine 1 est exerçable par la règle des autorités détenues (A2, B2), puisque 3 a `Modify` effectif sur 0. Elle couvre la feuille de 2, dont elle est l'origine.
     - Après `release 2`, l'appelé écrit la feuille 1 par la racine 1.

   Dans les deux cas, l'appelant a donné l'accès par un autre paramètre. Ce qui tient sans hypothèse est prouvé (`call_params_effective_protected`) : tant que le paramètre est actif, toute autorité qui a un mode effectif sur sa feuille est lui ou un de ses descendants (I1). Question (e) 1.
2. **F7 (a), « le second `store` est rejeté ».** Il est accepté ; l'état, le pas et la raison sont en (p). Il n'y a pas d'énoncé à prouver : c'est un verdict.
3. **`store_escape_rejected_at_transfer`, lu sur le détenteur.** L'étape 3 demande qu'« une valeur tenant une autorité dérivée d'un local du cadre courant ne [puisse] être transférée vers un cadre plus ancien ». Le théorème le prouve pour une autorité ancrée sur la valeur ou un de ses champs, ce que fait `store`, dont l'ancre effective est du cadre courant et ne suit pas la valeur ; elle peut être détenue par le cadre ou par un local qui en possède un autre (`hw3`).

   Pour une autorité seulement détenue, l'énoncé est faux sur l'état atteint `lb5` (`lb5_reachable`) :
   - le local 5 du cadre 2 détient le bloc 8, issu de `internal` 7, dérivée de la racine du tampon local 3 ;
   - `issue` ne pose pas le bloc dans les ancres de sa destination (A10) ;
   - `transfer 5 0` vers le résultat de l'appelant est accepté, et le bloc passe à un emplacement du cadre 1 ;
   - seule la sortie du cadre 2 est rejetée (O7, A7 : le bloc survit, ses ancêtres non).

   Question (e) 3.
4. **Cas `x2`, « seconde arène sur la même racine → reject ».**
   - Rejeté quand la seconde arène nomme la racine 3 pour `internal` (F1 : garde par `internal`). Dans l'état du cas, toute seconde arène sur 3 ou 4 est rejetée, faute d'autre autorité admissible (énoncé par `decide` sur tout indice d'autorité).
   - Accepté quand l'appelant dérive d'abord 4 de la racine et la stocke dans une valeur : `newArena 3 4` réussit alors que la première arène vit (témoin `y3`).
   - Le comportement suit F1 (garde par indice retirée). Le module comptait déjà deux arènes vivantes sur la même feuille (`x5`, arène imbriquée). Question (e) 4.
5. **Inchangés** : passe 5, (d) 3 (`arena_inv_preserved` sous `hlive`), 4 et 5.
6. **Résolus par cette tâche.**
   - Passe 5, (d) 1 (possession par le cadre 0) : F3 confirme l'élément propriétaire, et `static_not_owned_by_frame0` reste comme témoin de comportement légal.
   - Passe 5, (d) 2 (arène imbriquée de valeur distincte) : F1 la rend réalisable (cas `na0`…`na4`).

## (e) Questions pour arbitrage

Questions de la passe 5 tranchées :
- 1 par F3 ;
- 2 par F1 ;
- 3 par F1 (garde par `internal`) ;
- 4 par F2 ;
- 6 par F1.

Reste ouverte la 5 (`available` et `issued` dans l'entrée ; le module les garde). Reste aussi la question 13 de la passe 2 (`WF3` dans la spécification).

Questions nouvelles :

1. **F6** ((d) 1). Quel énoncé ? Trois options :
   - restreindre la protection aux paramètres dont aucun ancêtre strict n'est exerçable par l'appelé au moment de l'appel ;
   - n'énoncer que la forme active (`call_params_effective_protected`) ;
   - ou ajouter une règle, par exemple refuser à `enterFrame` deux paramètres liés par l'origine, ou un paramètre dont un ancêtre est détenu par un emplacement que couvre un autre paramètre ?
2. **F7 (a)** ((p)). `store` accepte un cycle après lequel, dans `fa8`, aucune des deux autorités stockées n'est exerçable ni libérable. La seule séquence connue qui les libère avant la sortie du cadre finit l'arène ; qu'une séquence les libère en gardant l'arène vivante reste ouvert. Faut-il :
   - refuser un `store a p` dont le droit `Modify` sur `p` n'est justifié que par une autorité que `a` rend exerçable (cycle) ;
   - ou accepter ce comportement ?
3. **« Une valeur tenant une autorité »** ((d) 3). Faut-il lire « tenant » comme « ancrée par `store` » (forme prouvée) ? Sinon, deux options :
   - que `issue` ancre le bloc sur sa destination ;
   - ou que `transfer` contrôle aussi les autorités dérivées qu'il change de détenteur (O4.5, O4.6), l'échappement d'un bloc n'étant aujourd'hui rejeté qu'à la sortie du cadre ?
4. **Deux arènes vivantes sur les mêmes feuilles** ((d) 4). F1 l'admet quand leurs `internal` diffèrent. Les invariants tiennent : l'arène dont l'`internal` a un descendant actif ne peut plus émettre ni se réinitialiser (`IssueRight`, `ResetPre`). Est-ce voulu ?
5. **« `endUse` des nœuds » dans F7 (b)** ((c) 10). Les valeurs qui détiennent les blocs, comme le module le lit, ou les parties du stockage ? Dans le second cas, la séquence de la tâche est rejetée au premier `endUse` ((p)).
